title: HIV Customer Representative - South Florida
description:
Job Description

The HIV Customer Representative is a key member of the Customer Team and plays a critical role in supporting our Company's customer centric business model. This position is responsible for working with the Customer Team to understand and identify customer needs, supporting pull-through activities relative to the customer strategy, keeping with our Company's values and standards as governed by our policies and ensuring that our Company is viewed as demonstrating better health outcomes to healthcare professionals and their patients. The HIV Customer Representative demonstrates professionalism and leadership by modeling the required knowledge for successful execution of all Field Sales competencies.

Territory Information:

  • This is a field-based sales position that is responsible for covering the Southeast Florida, Miami Dade and Broward counties territory.

  • This role also includes and is not limited to South Florida.

  • The ideal location to reside is within this territory or within a reasonable commuting distance to those workload centers.

  • Travel (%) varies based on candidate’s location within the geography.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Communicates product information in a way that's meaningful and relevant to each individual customer; customizes discussions and client interactions based on understanding of customer's needs.

  • Engages in informed discussions about products with HCP customers – knowing when/how to seek and provide additional information.

  • Within select customer accounts, acts as primary point of contact for customer, meets with key customers/personnel to understand practice structure, business model, key influencers (IDS, ADAP, DOC, VAs, DOH)/network structure, customer needs and identifies business opportunities.

  • For select customer accounts/HCPs, coordinates with customer team to develop customer strategy – outlining strategy for interactions/ relationship, solutions and potential offerings for customer.

  • Shares learnings and best practices from one customer to help other customers meet their needs.

  • Demonstrates a focus on better health outcomes (considers the HCP & patient experience).

  • Provides input into resource allocation decisions across customers.

  • Identifies and selects programs/services available in the library of our "resources" to address customer needs.

  • Maintains current understanding of practice structure, business model, key influencers/ network structure and makes information available to relevant stakeholders.

  • Influences beyond their specific geography or product area.

  • Embraces and maximizes new technological capabilities and channels to engage customers.

  • Engages in all job responsibilities and activities with the highest standards of ethics and integrity, with particular emphasis on compliance with all relevant laws, policies and regulations.

HIV Specific:

The HIV Customer Representative demonstrates the ability to execute at each stage of the sales process. This role creates a compelling and logical rationale in positioning our Company's HIV products versus the competition by focusing on appropriate patient types and use of supportive approved resources.

  • Demonstrates the ability to stay ahead of market trends, assesses impact of dynamics on current business state and makes proactive recommendations to meet the future needs of the business. Demonstrates innovation, resilience and is able to adapt to ambiguous/evolving business environments.

  • Demonstrates advanced ability to ask strategic, insightful questions to obtain information on customer healthcare needs. Uses the insights to position HIV products and collaborates with customers on focused and customized business strategy.

  • Demonstrates the ability to identify customer/market segments and industry conditions in local market. Special emphasis on Specialty Pharmacy to leverage business opportunities and understanding of HIV products distribution channels/challenges.

  • Demonstrates the ability to drive results by appropriately managing the total Virology product portfolio by prioritizing individual opportunities and plan execution through customer segmentation, targeting and business analysis.

  • Articulates the complexities of the HIV payer environment, recognizing the role each stakeholder plays in the ability to access our company's Virology product portfolio.

  • Demonstrates the ability to apply understanding of account needs and inter-dependencies in order to develop and execute account plans. Collaborates and models teamwork with extended members of the Virology Account Team (CLs, CTLs, Managed Care, Marketing) in the development of long-term account plans and customer centric solutions to improve value for both customers and patients.

  • Demonstrates the ability to embrace and maximize current and future technological capabilities and multi-channel opportunities to engage customers.

  • Demonstrates high-level collaboration skills to optimally maximize customer interactions and territory management with cross-functional Virology and non-Virology stakeholders such as Community Liaisons, IDS executives, fellow District members etc.

  • Demonstrates the ability to forge and manage business relationships with difficult to access customers in a “no sample” environment.

  • Demonstrates ability to function effectively and employ a “business owner mindset” during business cycles undergoing a high degree of change, including flexing across customer segments, product portfolios, and working in flexible matrix configurations.

  • Demonstrates high-level compliance with all Company policies and procedures.

Position Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with at least 2 years Sales experience OR a minimum of high school diploma with at least 6 years of equivalent experience which could include professional sales, experience in marketing, military or healthcare/scientific field that is not sales related (pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical devices).

  • Valid Driver's license.

  • Willing to travel within the assigned territory to visit customers in-person and for national sales meetings/conferences.

Preferred Experience and Skills:

  • Minimum of two (2) years working in one or more of the following areas: account management or sales experience working with Infectious Disease customers, with a preference for HIV product experience and/or launch experience.

  • Exceptional bilingual communication skills (Spanish/English). Ability to build trusting relationships and present strategic proposals to international clients in both languages.

  • Preference for specialty sales experience across multiple specialty markets with a preference for launch experience.

  • Experience in pharma, biotech or medical device sales.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing plans for engaging customers and meeting customer needs.

  • Demonstrated success in establishing, developing and maintaining relationships.

  • Prior experience working in a highly regulated industry or environment where compliance to laws and policies is critical.

  • Account experience working in complex hospital systems, teaching Institutions and community hospitals.

  • Demonstrated skill set to identify account inter-dependencies and build partnerships with key stakeholders/departments.

  • Experience with complex payer environments, recognizing the role each stakeholder plays in the ability to access the product portfolio, especially pharmacy stakeholders.

  • Current disease state customers acknowledge individual as a trusted and reliable representative.

  • Experience interacting with scientific thought leaders and developing advocates across an adoption continuum.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop customer relationships in a challenging-to-access or “no sampling” environment.

  • High level of business acumen and account management skills.

  • Current relationships with key opinion leaders within designated account preferred.

  • Leadership, planning and organization, self-motivation and initiative, ability to learn, understand and convey complex information.

  • Understanding of the value and importance of approaching job responsibilities with ethics and integrity and working in a highly compliant environment.

title: Lead Product Manager – AI & Trust Intelligence
description:
emergiTEL is hiring a Lead Product Manager – AI & Trust Intelligence for our client in the telecommunications and digital identity industry. This is a Permanent role.
Compensation: $160,000 - $180,000/year
Location: Toronto, ON

Job Description

About the Role

We are seeking a high-impact Lead Product Manager – AI & Trust Intelligence to own and lead the development of AI-powered data products across the client Trust Platform, a mobile identity and trust intelligence platform.
This role is pivotal in defining how the client transforms authoritative mobile network, device, SIM, account, and identity signals into intelligent products that help enterprises make better decisions across onboarding, authentication, account protection, transaction monitoring, and fraud prevention.
You will lead initiatives across AI-powered trust scoring, fraud risk intelligence, anomaly detection, model explainability, decisioning workflows, and customer-facing insights. You will partner closely with engineering, data science, sales, product, and enterprise customers to build intelligence that enables trust at scale.

AI Product Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and own the product strategy for AI and Trust Intelligence products, including trust scores, risk signals, decisioning models, model outputs, reason codes, and customer-facing insights.

  • Build a cohesive multi-year product roadmap aligned to business priorities, carrier data capabilities, enterprise customer needs, fraud trends, and evolving regulatory expectations.

  • Drive the vision for next-generation mobile identity intelligence, including AI-powered fraud detection, adaptive risk scoring, identity reputation, signal intelligence, and real-time trust decisioning.

Trust Intelligence & AI Model Productization

  • Lead the development of AI/ML-powered trust data and intelligence products, supporting orchestration across signals, rules, and models.

  • Productize AI models into practical enterprise offerings, including APIs, batch outputs, dashboards, reports, decision engines, and workflow integrations.

  • Define customer-facing score interpretation, reason codes, confidence indicators, and model explainability requirements.

  • Co-establish product metrics for model performance and customer value, including precision, recall, false positive rates, lift, stability, drift, coverage, conversion impact, fraud reduction, and operational efficiency with Data and AI partners.

  • Build processes for continuous model improvement using customer outcomes, feedback data, fraud signals, and partner insights.

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Lead discovery sessions that translate customer problems into AI product opportunities, pilot designs, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design proof-of-value programs that demonstrate the impact of AI and trust intelligence data products.

  • Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to support enterprise adoption, customer success, and product-led growth.

  • Develop clear product narratives, demos, use case playbooks, and technical explanations that make AI outputs understandable and actionable for business, fraud, risk, and technology stakeholders.

  • Work with carrier partners and strategic data providers to identify opportunities to deepen signal coverage, data quality, and product differentiation.

Responsible AI, Privacy & Compliance Alignment

  • Ensure AI product capabilities are explainable, auditable, measurable, and appropriate for high-trust enterprise environments.

  • Partner with privacy, legal, security, data governance, and AI governance teams to ensure AI capabilities are developed with privacy-by-design and secure-by-design principles.

  • Maintain alignment with applicable privacy, identity, fraud, and risk management expectations, including PIPEDA, data governance requirements, AI governance, customer contractual obligations, and emerging responsible AI practices.

What You Bring

  • 6 to 8+ years of product management experience in AI/ML products, data products, fraud/risk, digital identity, cybersecurity, fintech, telecom, enterprise SaaS, or decisioning platforms.

  • Experience working closely with data science, machine learning, data engineering, software engineering, architecture, privacy, and security teams.

  • Experience taking AI, analytics, scoring, or data products from discovery through production launch and ongoing optimization.

  • Familiarity with model development workflows, including feature engineering, labels, training data, evaluation metrics, monitoring, feedback loops, and model governance.

  • Experience with fraud prevention, identity verification, digital onboarding, authentication, account takeover, synthetic identity, scams, KYC, AML, or transaction monitoring is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with APIs, data platforms, scoring engines, analytics dashboards, decisioning systems, or customer-facing data products.

Skills

  • Strong product instincts and ability to balance customer needs, AI capability, privacy expectations, security requirements, and user experience.

  • Ability to translate complex AI, data, and technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executives, customers, and cross-functional teams.

  • Strong understanding of AI/ML product concepts, including model performance, explainability, precision/recall, false positives, drift, confidence scores, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data, metrics, APIs, risk signals, product analytics, and customer outcome measurement.

  • Familiarity with privacy-by-design, secure-by-design, responsible AI, and enterprise data governance principles.

  • Customer-facing confidence with the ability to support sales, pilots, executive briefings, technical discovery, and product demos.

title: Quality Control Technician
description:
Summary:

We are currently looking for a Quality Control Technician to join our Quality Control group. This position will help scientists propagate plants from seeds, conduct insect and plant bioassays, maintain fungal cultures, test materials for QC release, and will generate test records that are accurate, concise, and complete. The QC Technician should possess basic knowledge of biology and be familiar with general lab equipment and practices.


RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

Essential Functions

  • Assist in the propagation of plants from seed, maintaining fungal cultures and setting up bioassays
  • Conduct microbial, insect, and plant bioassays, evaluate and record results
  • Set up, sterilize, clean, calibrate, and maintain lab equipment
  • Prepare a variety of media types and laboratory reagents
  • Perform raw material and finished product sampling, and testing assuring adequate, appropriate, and complete documentation
  • Collect, input, and organize test data, and report results
  • Assist in maintaining product retains and inventory
  • Be aware of Quality Control and manufacturing policies, safety concerns, and environmental conditions that can affect product quality
  • Comply with quality systems procedures, as applicable
  • Support other lab functions as required


Other Duties

  • Comply with all safety policies, practices and procedures, and report all unsafe activities to appropriate supervisor.
  • Participate in efforts to achieve departmental and company goals.
  • Provide leadership to others through example and sharing of knowledge and skill.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


REQUIREMENTS:

Education: An Associate’s degree in a Biological discipline or two years of equivalent educational or work experience is required for this position.


Experience: This position shall preferably have previous hands-on lab experience, exposure to aseptic technique, prior experience working with insects in a regulated laboratory setting a plus.


Essential Physical and Mental Requirements

Physical Requirements:

  • The Quality Control Technician must have manual dexterity and vision sufficient to handle and perceive attributes of very small insects.
  • Must be able to function in working conditions that are adequately lighted, moderately heated or air-conditioned, and in an indoor office, laboratory, and production setting.
  • In the course of daily activities, technicians will be required to lift up to 50 pounds, stand for long periods of time, are frequently exposed to water, insects, air contamination such as disagreeable odors, and may be exposed to toxic or caustic substances which will require the use of applicable PPE such as safety glasses, lab coats, and respirators.


Mental Requirements:

  • Ability to work with frequent interruptions and changes in workload priorities, ability to prioritize tasks, ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, regulations, and laboratory procedures. Possess the ability to write documents and report data. Effectively present information and respond to questions from managers and peers.
  • Able to calculate figures and amounts such as area, length, and volume. Able to calculate and apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and statistical functions to practical situations.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Able to interpret a variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and ability to deal with nonverbal symbolism such as graphs, formulas, and scientific equations.
  • Possess intermediate personal computer skills including electronic mail, routine database activity, word processing, spreadsheets, and graphics.
  • Must have good organizational and record keeping skills and be capable of handling and carrying out multiple tasks and projects simultaneously under stringent deadlines. Must be able to work effectively in a multi-project environment. Must be detail oriented.


Travel:

  • No travel is required for this position.


Compensation:

  • ProFarm offers a comprehensive benefits package including a 401(k) plan with employer match, and a health plan including medical and dental coverage, life insurance coverage, long term disability and a flexible spending account for dependent care and/or medical expenses.
  • The above is a list of the essential duties and responsibilities for this position. This list is not all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned. This job description may be modified as needed.
  • ProFarm is an equal-opportunity employer. A pre-employment background check will be required.

title: Tempest Practitioner
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented TEMPEST Practitioner to join our team in Springfield, VA.

The TEMPEST Practitioner will leverage their strong technical background and knowledge to support technical security efforts, to include creating technical documentation, responding to required controls, and completing required tasks and actions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Assisting in executing technical assessments, inspections, evaluations, and reviews accurately and within established timeframes.
  • Supporting the implementation and management of technical security programs, which includes analyzing requirements and developing processes to control or mitigate compromising emanations.
  • Providing technical guidance and assistance by collecting necessary information, such as drawings, wiring diagrams, and equipment specifications, and assisting with workflow requests.
  • Conducting technical testing and visual inspections of facilities, systems, and equipment, including shielded enclosures and distribution systems.
  • Representing technical interests in meetings concerning classified information processing, providing detailed assessments of technical scope, and ensuring accurate reporting.
  • Managing daily operations, maintaining the accuracy of automated workflow processes, and overseeing annual technical evaluations.
  • Maintaining technical readiness, qualifications, and test equipment maintenance and calibration as per relevant policies.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma/GED with 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in technical security, TEMPEST, or facility inspection related fields.
  • Significant experience navigating facility evaluation processes and national technical security requirements.
  • Significant experience meeting security requirements in specialized technical environments or similar environments.
  • Experience working across a large team to drive a security agenda and working with complex, intertwined systems.
  • Experience inventorying complex facility layouts, and with technical documentation such as shielding, grounding, and distribution systems.
  • Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex information technology documentation, particularly facility and security documentation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Credentialed graduate of an accredited federal or Counterintelligence training academy.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Possess advanced technical security training and certifications for completion of foundational and facility design courses.
  • Self-starter with excellent people skills - able to work across teams, organize meetings/boards, and drive change throughout an organization.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must have an active TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain/maintain a polygraph.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

title: Data Operations/Reliability Engineer
description:
We are partnering with a leading global multi-strategy hedge fund to look for a Data Operations Engineer to join their team in Singapore.

You’ll play a key role in ensuring the reliability and performance of the firm’s critical data platforms by monitoring data pipelines, investigating data quality issues, and identifying anomalies. The role also focuses on enhancing observability, building automation, and continuously improving monitoring tools and processes to increase the resilience, scalability, and efficiency of the data ecosystem.

Requirements

  • Strong technical foundation with experience working with data platforms
  • Hands-on experience building automation solutions and driving continuous improvements to operational processes.
  • A strong focus on enhancing platform reliability, availability, and resilience through automation, testing, and standardisation.
  • Experience programming in Python or another modern language such as Java, Go, C#, or Scala.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with large-scale datasets and data analysis tools (e.g. Pandas, Snowflake, Elasticsearch/Kibana).
  • Exposure to orchestration and data workflow technologies such as Airflow, Dagster, Argo, Spark, or Hive.
  • Familiarity with containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving skills, with a methodical approach to investigating production issues.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with global engineering teams.

Regrettably, only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: System Verification Engineer
description:

Do you enjoy hands-on verification work and taking ownership of end-to-end functionality in complex technical environments? Then this could be an interesting opportunity for you! ALTEN is now proactively looking for Verification Engineers to clients within the automotive industry.

  • Develop, execute, and improve test methods and verification approaches
  • Perform exploratory and requirement-based testing
  • Work hands-on with test environments, rigs, or target platforms
  • Support development of simulations and test utilities
  • Document verification results, test methods, and quality status

Your profile

You are a structured and analytical engineer who enjoys hands-on verification and system-level problem solving. You are comfortable working in cross-functional, agile teams and take ownership of your work from planning to delivery.

We see that you have:

In Sweden, we are about 1,300 committed employees across 9 cities – from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north. For the fifth consecutive year, ALTEN has been recognized as one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, thanks to our strong focus on career development, innovation, and engineering excellence.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Remote

Experience: Project Coordination, Project Management, Operations, or Administrative Support Roles


Company Description

Scry AI is a research-led enterprise AI company that builds intelligent platforms for BFSI, insurance, logistics, and industrial enterprises to drive efficiency, insight, and compliance. Our product suite includes Auriga for conversational AI, Collatio for document intelligence, and Concentio for cognitive IoT and operational intelligence. These platforms help clients convert complex, fragmented data into actionable enterprise intelligence.


We are looking for a Project Coordinator to support the successful planning, execution, and delivery of projects by ensuring seamless coordination across teams and stakeholders. This role is critical in keeping projects organized, on schedule, and aligned with business objectives.


Role Overview

As a Project Coordinator at Scry AI, you will work closely with project managers, product teams, engineering, and business stakeholders to coordinate day-to-day project activities. You will be responsible for tracking progress, maintaining project documentation, facilitating communication, and helping ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.


This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced technology environment.


Key Responsibilities


Project Planning & Coordination

  • Support project planning, scheduling, and execution activities
  • Coordinate tasks, timelines, and deliverables across multiple teams
  • Track project progress and ensure milestones are achieved on schedule


Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain project documentation, meeting notes, and status reports
  • Prepare project dashboards and progress updates for stakeholders
  • Ensure project records are accurate, organized, and up to date


Stakeholder Communication

  • Coordinate meetings, follow up on action items, and facilitate communication across teams
  • Serve as a point of contact for project-related updates and coordination
  • Escalate risks, issues, and delays to project managers when required


Risk & Process Support

  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks
  • Assist in implementing mitigation plans and resolving coordination challenges
  • Support continuous improvement of project management processes and workflows


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with product, engineering, operations, and business teams to support project delivery
  • Help ensure alignment between project objectives and business priorities
  • Contribute to a collaborative and efficient project environment


Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience in project coordination, project management support, or operations coordination
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Project is preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment


Our Ideal Candidate

  • Is highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Can coordinate multiple activities while maintaining accuracy
  • Communicates effectively with technical and business teams
  • Takes initiative and follows through on tasks and deadlines
  • Thrives in a collaborative, technology-driven environment
  • Is interested in AI, enterprise technology, and project delivery


If this role interests you, follow our page to stay updated on more job opportunities and insights into how AI companies successfully manage projects, collaborate across teams, and deliver innovative enterprise solutions.

title: Field Coordinator
description:
Department

Field Operations

Reports To

The Field Coordinator will report to the Assistant Superintendent and/ or Site Superintendent

Brief Overview

The Field Coordinator will report to the Assistant Superintendent and/ or the Site Superintendent to assist in the day-to-day site coordination of all construction activities. The Field Coordinator will learn about safety, quality, progress, schedule, and any other project matters.

Key Functions & Duties

  • Assists in creating, maintaining, and executing the project plan and schedule; and ensuring compliance with budget.
  • Assists the Assistant Superintendents, Project Managers, and Assistant Superintendents
  • Creates a team atmosphere within project teams, inclusive of subcontractors and trade labour.
  • Coordinates construction activities as directed by the Field Team.
  • Ensures project materials and workmanship meet the project Quality Standards and Design requirements.
  • Obtains necessary information from engineers, designers, inspectors, municipal/provincial authorities, and owners when directed by the Field staff
  • Advises Field Team of potential problems, work interferences or schedule difficulties while assisting in circumventing/resolving such conflicts; anticipates and resolves project issues and schedule difficulties.
  • Assists the Field Team in maintaining the project’s Daily Job Diary, as-built tracking, creating templates for future as-built tracking.
  • Attend relevant project meetings when required.
  • Assists Superintendent and Safety Consultant with daily notes and supervision.
  • Photo documentation and narrative to photos as required.
  • Assist Superintendent with data input for tracking purposes (ie. concrete tickets)
  • Assist Superintendent with daily traffic notifications to neighboring properties and ensure good relations with neighbours.
  • Tracking/ counting trucks leaving the site when required.
  • Input daily deliveries into Procore for tracking purposes.
  • Adding/uploading items to Procore as required by the Field staff.
  • Collecting documentation from trades and tracking as required (ie. safety docs)
  • Ensuring paperwork is organized and available when required (ie. orientation tracking)

Requirements

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Post-secondary school degree or diploma in a construction related area of study.
  • Minimum of 3 years of direct work experience working in high-rise / ICI construction.
  • Health & Safety certifications.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Basic understanding of construction methodology, including development, contracting, and consulting.
  • Basic trade/ product knowledge
  • Basic knowledge of the construction industry and company operations specifically construction specifications, building materials, methods, and procedures
  • Understanding of construction terminology
  • Technical Systems (Procore, Office 365)
  • Safety Codes
  • Understanding of construction codes
  • Ability to read drawings
  • Office Trailer presence
  • Site Administration Management
  • Ability to handle pressure

Core Competencies

  • Action Oriented
  • Demonstrates Self-Awareness
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Self-Development
  • Resourcefulness
  • Instills Trust
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus

Working Conditions

  • Work in both an office setting and outdoors at multiple construction sites.
  • Travel to the site, and off-site may be required.
  • Frequently required to sit or stand for long periods.
  • Walking, bending, and kneeling is common.
  • May need to climb ladders or navigate inclined ramps at job sites.
  • Personal protective equipment will be required, e.g., steel-toed safety boots, safety glasses/goggles, hard hat, etc.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, tools, and to handle other computer components.
  • Ability to work in a variety of weather conditions.
  • Ability to move safely over uneven terrain when onsite.
  • Ability to respond quickly to sounds when onsite.
  • Ability to see and respond to dangerous situations when onsite.

What we offer:

  • Competitive Compensation Package. - The estimated starting salary range for this role is $67,500 - $80,000 annually. Base salaries are determined according to several parameters like skills, experience, and potential impact on the role. Internal and external competitiveness are also taken into account in our offers. Final compensation will be confirmed as part of a personalized offer.

title: Telefonsäljare / Mötesbokare (Hybrid)

Internutbildning: Gedigen introduktion inom B2B-telefonsälj, retorik, objection handling och CRM-hantering.

Karriärmöjligheter: Goda chanser till utveckling inom bolaget för dig som visar framfötterna.

Vi söker dig som älskar att kommunicera via telefon och drivs av att skapa resultat. Du har en stark inre motor, är uthållig och låter dig inte slås ut av ett nej.

Du är:

*Målmedveten, uthållig och tävlingsinriktad.

*Social, förtroendeingivande och kommunikativ med en utmärkt telefonröst.

*Strukturerad och van vid att arbeta målinriktat med uppsatta aktivitetsmål.

*Ansvarstagande med hög arbetsmoral, kapabel att arbeta disciplinerat på distans.

Om Ulricehamns Mediebyrå

Ulricehamns Mediebyrå är ett dynamiskt teknik- och IT-företag med fokus på programmering, digital synlighet och cybersäkerhet för företag och offentlig sektor. Vi levererar moderna systemlösningar som skapar spårbar verklig nytta för våra kunder.

Ansökan

Är du modig, driven, hjälpsam och ansvarfull?

Låter detta som din nästa utmaning?

Michael Galatanu VD, Ulricehamns Mediebyrå AB

title: VP Data Center Solutions – APO Region
description:
VP Data Center Solutions – APO Region

Location: Singapore (preferred), with significant travel across the APO Region.

Compensation: Highly competitive executive package, negotiable depending on experience.

Reporting Line: Managing Director, Data Center Solutions.


The opportunity is for a global leader in advanced heat exchange and cooling technology, delivering high-performance solutions for some of the world's most demanding applications. With more than 90 years of engineering expertise, operations in over 80 countries, and manufacturing facilities across Europe, the Americas, and Asia, the company has built a reputation for innovation, energy efficiency, and reliability. Its products are trusted by leading OEMs, industrial manufacturers, and mission-critical operators worldwide.


Today, the company is at the forefront of the rapidly growing data centre cooling market, providing cutting-edge dry coolers, adiabatic systems, condensers, and heat exchangers that support hyperscale, colocation, and AI-driven facilities. With a strong focus on sustainable cooling, continuous R&D investment, and long-term customer partnerships, the company offers the opportunity to join a global business that is shaping the future of thermal management and critical infrastructure.


The Opportunity

The VP Data Center Solutions – APO Region will spearhead the regional strategy, commercial management and project execution for the Data Center Solutions business, delivering significant profitable growth across the APO Region.

The successful candidate will have full end-to-end ownership of the regional business, including commercial performance, project execution and P&L responsibility. Working closely with the global leadership team, this individual will drive strategic growth, strengthen key customer relationships and build a high-performing regional organisation.


Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership

  • Spearhead the regional strategy, commercial management and project execution for the Data Center Solutions business, delivering significant profitable growth across the APO Region.
  • Own the overall performance of the Data Center Solutions business across the region.
  • Hold full financial responsibility for Order Intake, Revenue, Margin, EBIT and Cash Flow.
  • Build, lead, mentor and develop a highly capable, multi-disciplined regional team.
  • Foster a culture where customer service precision becomes the norm.

Business Development, Sales & Account Management

  • Develop and execute the regional Strategic Plan for the Data Center Solutions business.
  • Develop and implement the regional Go-To-Market Strategy in alignment with the global business strategy.

title: Personlig assistent som timvikarie till en 6-årig flicka i Vännäs
description:
På Kura Omsorg arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

OM TJÄNSTEN

Vi på Kura Omsorg söker dig som vill arbeta som personlig assistent hos vår kund i Vännäs. Vi erbjuder timvikariat med möjlighet att arbeta under dagtid, kvällstid, natt och helg – så du kan välja de tider som passar just dig bäst.

Arbetstiderna är förlagda enligt följande:

  • 08:00–14:15

  • 14:15–21:00

  • 21:00–08:00

Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse där vi gärna ser att du kan påbörja introduktion omgående.

OM KUNDEN

Vår kund är en sprudlande 6-årig tjej med glimten i ögat. Arbetsplatsen är förlagt till hennes hem där hon lever tillsammans med sina två mammor och syskon. Som assistent får du vara med på ett äventyr fullt av lek, glädje och fart!

Arbetsuppgifterna består främst av omvårdnad och övervakning av syresättningen. Vi har tydliga skriftliga rutiner och stöd i arbetsverktyg, och du kommer alltid att arbeta dubbelt med en kollega under varje pass för att säkerställa bästa möjliga omsorg.

Du och dina kollegor är viktiga för hennes utveckling. Tillsammans hjälper ni henne med daglig träning och kommunikation, och bidrar till hennes glädje och tillväxt. Hon älskar äventyr, att gunga och att läsa böcker - så förbered dig på dagar fyllda av lekfullhet, lärande och roliga upptäcktsfärder!

ÄR DU DEN VI SÖKER?

Vi söker en varm och engagerad assistent som är barnkär, lyhörd och ansvarstagande. Det är en fördel om du har tidigare erfarenhet, både från arbetslivet och livet i stort, som du kan ha med dig in i tjänsten. Arbetsuppgifterna kräver att du kan behålla fokus och vara noggrann i de olika momenten.

Eftersom du kommer att arbeta i en stor personalgrupp är god samarbetsförmåga en viktig egenskap. Vi ser också att du är flexibel och gärna kan hoppa in med kort varsel vid kollegors frånvaro.

Välkommen att söka tjänsten och bli en del av hennes spännande värld.

KRAV

  • Ej allergisk mot pälsdjur

MERITER

  • Vårderfarenhet

  • Track-erfarenhet

  • Körkort

Sysselsättningsgrad: Timvikariat.

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal.

Din ansökan kommer att läsas av medarbetare på Kura Omsorg, kund och anhörig. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

För anställning hos oss på Kura Omsorg behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida. På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år för att arbeta som personlig assistent.

Om du ska arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdraget beställs av via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Utdragen kan beställas med BankID via följande länk: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning och de nya regler som trädde i kraft den 1 mars 2026.

ATT ARBETA PÅ KURA OMSORG

Som anställd personlig assistent hos oss omfattas du av kollektivavtal samt avtalspension. Du är försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag till alla våra anställda. Dessutom anordnar vi aktiviteter som riktar sig både till dig som anställd och till kunden du arbetar med. Vi är måna om att du som medarbetare ska trivas hos oss!

DELA KANDIDATER MELLAN BOLAGEN

Din ansökan kan komma att delas med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia. Du ger ditt medgivande i ansökan.

FÖR DIG MED ANSTÄLLNINGSSTÖD

Om du som söker har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd tar vi som arbetsgivare på Kura Omsorg även detta i beaktning vid en eventuell anställning. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

title: Resande installatör till affärsområde Defence - Växjö
description:
Tekniska utmaningar, frihet under ansvar och resor över hela Sverige

OneCo Networks söker en resande installatör till affärsområde Defence. Rollen passar dig som arbetar noggrant, uppskattar varierande arbetsuppgifter och vill utvecklas tillsammans i en stimulerande miljö.

Några viktiga förutsättningar för rollen

Vi vill vara tydliga med vad tjänsten innebär, så att du redan från början kan bedöma om rollen passar dig. Fundera därför på om du kan svara ja på följande frågor:

  • Är du införstådd med att tjänsten kräver en godkänd säkerhetsprövning och villig att genomgå den?
  • Är du bekväm med att tjänsten innebär cirka 150 hotellnätter per år?
  • Är du bekväm med att arbeta på hög höjd och klättra i master och torn på mellan 30 och 60 meter?
  • Har du B-körkort?
  • Är du svensk medborgare?

Om du känner att detta stämmer in på dig, fortsätt gärna läsa. Då kan det här vara rätt nästa steg för dig.

Vad rollen innebär

Som installatör på OneCo blir ingen dag den andra lik. Din arbetsplats är hela Sverige och arbetsuppgifterna omfattar allt från installation av kablage, routrar och radiolänkutrustning till montering av 48-volts kraftsystem. Arbetet innebär ibland om avbrottsfri installation av kraft, och ibland om att klättra i master för att montera antenner och fästen på upp till 600 kilo.

Arbetet sker främst i tvåmannateam och du får stor frihet under ansvar.

Kvalitet och noggrannhet är avgörande i rollen. Vi prioriterar att arbetet blir rätt utfört, även när det innebär att det behöver få ta lite längre tid. Installationerna godkänns genom fysisk besiktning tillsammans med kunden, vilket ställer höga krav på ett noggrant och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt.

Vad vi erbjuder dig

På OneCo blir du en del av ett engagerat team där säkerhet, tydliga mål och medarbetarutveckling står i fokus. Från din första dag får du stöd i din utveckling mot att på sikt kunna bli ledande montör.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats med varierande och utmanande arbetsuppgifter samt goda möjligheter att utvecklas både i rollen och som person.

Du får även tillgång till förmåner som:

  • friskvårdsbidrag
  • ersättning för läkarvård och receptbelagd medicin upp till högkostnadsskyddet
  • hemgaragerad arbetsbil för att underlätta dina resor

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du

Krav

  • B-körkort
  • svenskt medborgarskap
  • verktygsvana
  • datorvana
  • möjlighet att resa i tjänsten i den omfattning som rollen kräver
  • vilja och förmåga att arbeta på hög höjd
  • möjlighet att genomgå och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning

Mastintyg: Mastintyg krävs för att arbeta i rollen, men du behöver inte ha det när du söker. Det finns möjlighet att ta mastintyg under anställningen.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av

  • installation av kablage
  • kraft- eller elinstallation
  • montering och demontering av routrar och switchar
  • montering och demontering av radiolänkutrustning
  • montering av antenner och fästen i mast
  • driftsättning och installation av mjukvara i teknisk utrustning
  • andra arbetsuppgifter inom telekom

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är noggrann, lösningsfokuserad och flexibel. Du har öga för detaljer, tar ansvar för ditt arbete och trivs med att samarbeta nära en kollega.

Eftersom rollen innebär kontakter både internt och med kunder behöver du också vara trygg i din kommunikation och ha ett professionellt bemötande. Du behöver ha god datorvana, särskilt i Office-programmen.

Ansök idag

Låter tjänsten intressant och stämmer de viktiga förutsättningarna in på dig? Då ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta resurschef Stefan Fredriksson på mailto:stefan.fredriksson@oneco.se.

Intervjuer genomförs löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare, med 6 månaders provanställning

Arbetstid: Dagtid, men kvälls- och nattarbete kan förekomma.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Placeringsort: Växjö

Lön: Månadslön, övriga ersättningar enligt kollektivavtal. Förmåner.

Körkort: B Körkort krävs

Medborgarskap: Svenskt medborgarskap då tjänsten kräver godkänd säkerhetsprövning

Vi sköter rekryteringen internt och undanber oss därför kontakt från rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag.

title: Barnvakt Nanny Solna 0-2 gng/v
description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!

Om uppdraget / About the assignment

Familj med två barn på 8 år och 3,5 år. De behöver hjälp cirka 16 timmar i månaden och varierar mellan 0 och 2 tillfällen i veckan. Hämtning på vardagar främst kl. 16–19 samt ibland dagtid på helger, som längst till omkring kl. 18–19. Familjen är anpassningsbar kring dagar och tider.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

  • Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
  • Kurs i barn-HLR
  • Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
  • Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
  • Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
  • Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
  • Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen


Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.

title: Project Engineer 1
description:
Project Engineer - High Voltage Infrastructure

The Project Engineer will oversee the design and execution of high-voltage infrastructure projects, providing technical oversight to engineering teams responsible for detailed design activities. The role also supports engineering activities for EPC proposals and works closely with internal teams, clients, contractors, regulatory agencies, and other project stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee projects from inception through completion, including planning, design, permitting, construction support, and closeout.
  • Provide technical oversight and guidance to engineering teams performing detailed design.
  • Review engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical documentation for high-voltage substations and transmission line projects.
  • Support engineering activities associated with EPC proposals, estimates, and project development.
  • Monitor project budgets and schedules and identify opportunities for cost-effective solutions.
  • Ensure project designs and execution comply with applicable local, state, and federal regulations, industry standards, environmental requirements, and safety requirements.
  • Coordinate with clients, government agencies, contractors, utilities, and other stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
  • Oversee quality control processes to ensure engineering deliverables, workmanship, and materials meet established standards.
  • Prepare and maintain project status reports, engineering documentation, records, and other required project materials.
  • Identify and resolve technical and project-related issues throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Take responsibility for the quality, accuracy, and completeness of engineering work.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities in a complex environment.
  • Perform other engineering and project-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the electric utility industry, with experience performing detailed engineering for high-voltage substation projects.
  • Bachelor's or graduate degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited university.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.
  • Strong technical background in electrical, civil, structural, or mechanical engineering.
  • Comprehensive understanding of engineering principles and practices related to electric utility infrastructure.
  • Extensive knowledge of electric utility engineering and construction standards.
  • Experience with industry-specific engineering and design software.
  • Familiarity with project controls, cost estimating, scheduling, and project execution processes.
  • Experience supporting external customers and working directly with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, leadership, and collaboration skills.
  • Knowledge of applicable industry codes and standards, including ANSI, ASTM, ACI, AISC, IEEE, NEC, NESC, and related standards.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, establish priorities, and adapt to changing project requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in situations involving ambiguity.

Travel Requirements:

  • Travel may be required based on project and business needs, approximately 10-25% of the time.

title: Undersköterska till hemtjänst Åseda
description:
Genom våra värdeord mod, tolerans och kreativitet arbetar vi i Uppvidinge kommun för att ge god service och utveckla samhällsviktiga funktioner till våra invånare, besökare och företag. Uppvidinge kommun är kommunens största arbetsgivare med cirka 800 anställda. Hos oss vill vi att våra medarbetare ska känna stor delaktighet och det ska finnas utrymme för flexibilitet och utveckling.

Vi erbjuder ett meningsfullt arbete där vi tillsammans har möjlighet att verkligen göra skillnad för kommunens invånare. Välkommen med din ansökan och välkommen till en kommun med ett blomstrande näringsliv, ett rikt föreningsliv och närhet till naturen!




4 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Nu söker vi dig, som med ett engagerat och ansvarstagande förhållningssätt vill arbeta som undersköterska inom Hemtjänsten i Åseda, i Uppvidinge kommun. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta nära människor, skapa trygghet och bidra till att våra invånare kan leva ett meningsfullt liv där du i din roll har ett professionellt, varmt och individanpassat bemötande. Vi arbetar efter socialtjänstlagen och den nationella värdegrunden med fokus på individens behov i centrum.

Arbetsuppgifterna som undersköterska innefattar bland annat:

	• Personlig omvårdnad
	• Medicinskt delegerade uppgifter
	• Stöd vid måltider och dagliga aktiviteter
	• Social stimulans och trygghetsskapande insatser
	• Dokumentation i verksamhetssystem
	• Samarbete med kollegor, anhöriga och andra professioner

Arbetet är självständigt men med nära stöd av kollegor. Du möter människor i olika livssituationer och bidrar till att varje dag blir så bra som möjligt för dem. I yrkesrollen krävs att du visar respekt och hänsyn för dem du möter i ditt arbete. Du har en öppen och positiv attityd och har den enskildes behov som utgångspunkt för ditt agerande. Du har förmåga att arbeta tillsammans med andra för att utföra uppgifter och nå mål.

Vi kommer att hantera de inkomna ansökningarna löpande, vilket gör att vi kan komma att tillsätta tjänsterna innan sista dag för ansökan.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som:

	• Är utbildad undersköterska enligt Socialstyrelsens krav
	• Har ett genuint intresse för människor och ett professionellt bemötande
	• Är trygg, ansvarstagande och kan arbeta både självständigt och i team
	• Har god förmåga att dokumentera och kommunicera i det svenska språket
	• Har B-körkort

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Schema. Dag, kväll och helgarbete

Om du blir aktuell för anställning kommer arbetsgivaren att begära utdrag från belastningsregistret. Kommunstyrelsen har tagit ett beslut om att samtliga nyanställningar ska uppvisa belastningsregister innan anställning. Det utdrag som ska visas upp är utdraget för arbete inom skola eller förskola.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Uppvidinge kommun samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan digitalt och inte via e-post eller pappersformat.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Uppvidinge kommun tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

title: Erfaren miljö och energikonsult till Uppsala

Bolaget är ett väletablerat specialistföretag inom energi, miljö och processindustri med över 25 års erfarenhet. Med omkring 17 medarbetare är verksamheten etablerad i Mellansverige och befinner sig nu i en tillväxtfas där man bygger upp verksamheten i Uppsala.

Företaget arbetar främst mot kunder inom kraftvärme, industri, VA, energi och produktion. Uppdragen är ofta tekniskt komplexa och regulatoriskt styrda, med kunder som energibolag, processindustrier och större produktionsanläggningar runt om i Sverige.

• Samarbeta med kollegor inom energi, miljö, teknik och system

För rätt person finns möjlighet att ta ett större ansvar för uppdrag, kundrelationer och affärsutveckling.

• Har en högskoleutbildning inom energi, miljö eller motsvarande tekniskt område

• Har minst två års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet från processindustrin eller teknikkonsultbranschen

• Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med tekniska frågeställningar i industriell verksamhet

• Har förmåga att ta in, utvärdera, sammanställa och återge teknisk och juridisk information

• Har god social och pedagogisk förmåga

• Har ett genuint intresse för processindustrin och kundernas verksamhet

• Har ett tydligt driv och tar ansvar för att uppgifter och uppdrag går i mål

title: ABAP Consultant - BTP
description:

We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP Consultant – BTP with strong hands-on experience in ABAP development and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, extending, integrating, and supporting SAP solutions using modern ABAP technologies and BTP services. The consultant should have experience with ABAP on HANA, REST/OData APIs, CDS Views, RAP, SAP Fiori/UI5, and BTP integration/development services.

Automotive industry experience is preferred, particularly candidates who have worked with automotive OEMs, distributors, dealerships, or automotive-related organizations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with ABAP Cloud / Steampunk and cloud-compliant development approaches.

    • ABAP Objects
    • CDS Views
    • RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model)
    • OData services
    • REST APIs
    • BAPIs and RFCs

  • Develop and support SAP Fiori/UI5 applications where required.
  • Work with SAP HANA and develop optimized database solutions.
  • Design and implement integrations between SAP and external systems using SAP BTP Integration Suite and APIs.

  • Analyze technical requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions.
  • Perform code reviews, performance optimization, debugging, and troubleshooting.
  • Prepare technical specifications and development documentation.
  • Support unit testing, integration testing, and UAT.
  • Work closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders.
  • Provide technical support during implementation and post-go-live activities.
  • Follow SAP clean-core principles and cloud development best practices.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in SAP ABAP development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP BTP.
  • Strong knowledge of ABAP Objects and ABAP development.
  • Experience with ABAP on HANA.
  • Experience with CDS Views and AMDP.
  • Experience with RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model).
  • Strong experience developing OData and REST APIs.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA development and extensions.
  • Knowledge of SAP BTP Extension Suite.

  • Experience with SAP Fiori/UI5 is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) is a plus.
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Connector is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of SAP integration technologies.
  • Experience with debugging, performance optimization, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Automotive Experience – Preferred

  • Automotive industry experience is preferred.
  • Experience working with automotive OEMs, distributors, dealerships, or automotive service organizations is an advantage.
  • Experience developing SAP solutions for automotive business processes is a plus.
  • Experience working on SAP BTP/S/4HANA projects within an automotive environment is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Extrajobb som bingovärd i Luleå!
description:
Gillar du att stå i centrum, ta ansvar och sprida glädje? Sök extrajobb som Bingovärd i Luleå!

Våra Bingovärdar är våra ansikten utåt, det är deras engagemang och känsla för service som gör att våra gäster trivs hos oss. Som bingovärd får du en chans att utvecklas socialt då det ena arbetspasset inte är det andra likt. Samtidigt får du ta ansvar och arbeta självständigt för vi tror att ansvar får människor att växa. Arbetet innebär försäljning, sätta gästen i fokus och att ansvara för en positiv spelupplevelse.

Vi ger internutbildningar till alla våra nyanställda därför behöver du inte ha tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet även om det är meriterande. Viktigast är att du är beredd att ge oss ditt engagemang. I utbyte hjälper vi till att bygga på din CV, utvecklar dig och ger dig en rolig arbetsmiljö. Allt vårt överskott går till idrotten, sedan 1979 har Idrottens Bingo gett mer än 1,3 miljarder till idrottslivet. Det är ytterligare skäl som gör det roligt att arbeta hos just oss.

Vi vill att du är serviceinriktad, flexibel, ambitiös, stresstålig och klara av att jobba självständigt då man jobbar mestadels ensam. Det är bra om du är bekväm att tala i mikrofon inför människor och har lite ”skinn på näsan”. Huvudräkning och pengahantering får inte vara några problem och bra på att "ta folk" är ett måste.

Våra arbetsuppgifter innefattar bla. brickförsäljning, caféförsäljning, underhålla gästerna, städ och bingoredovisning.

Då vi är ett litet team som arbetar tillsammans kommer vi lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Hos oss råder laganda och det är viktigt att du har en utpräglad teamkänsla och värdesätter samarbete.

Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande.

Våra hallar har öppet de flesta dagar om året. Extraarbetet som Bingovärd innebär att man jobbar framförallt helg och kväll. Tjänsten passar dig som vill ha en extrainkomst vid sidan av exempelvis studier. Vi vill att du kan hoppa in vid extrapass, sjukdom och semester.

Då vi jobbar med spel är krav för tjänsten är att du är fyllda 18 år, pratar svenska, har fokus på att jobba och vill utvecklas inom försäljning och service.

Vi har öppet:

Mån-fre kl 11:15-21:00

Lördag 10:00-18:00

Sön kl 11:45-21:00

Tycker du att detta låter som en rolig utmaning? Skicka in din ansökan och berätta mer om dig själv, varför du söker och gärna lite kort om vad du gjort innan oavsett om det är studier eller jobb.

title: Graduation Candidate Advocate
description:
The Role
The Graduation Candidate Advocate is at the heart of our mission, building meaningful relationships with students to support their journey toward earning their high school diploma. Graduation Candidate Advocates act as mentors and advocates, providing both academic and non-academic support while fostering an environment where students feel valued and empowered.

This role is highly relationship-driven and persistence-focused, requiring consistent outreach, problem-solving, and a commitment to understanding and removing barriers that prevent students from attending and progressing. This role is ideal for recent graduates or early-career professionals looking to build experience in education, student support, or case management.


Key Responsibilities

Enrollment

  • Assist with the registration and enrollment process for new students.
  • Provide comprehensive support during student orientation to set the stage for success.

Retention and Attendance

  • Act as a case manager for a designated cohort of students, monitoring and documenting regular attendance.
  • Implement the Acceleration Academy Retention Protocol through proactive outreach (e.g., texts, calls, home visits).
  • Identify root causes of disengagement and work to remove barriers not just complete outreach attempts
  • Utilize technology tools for efficient daily monitoring and maintenance of student attendance and retention records.

Recruitment

  • Contribute to canvassing and recruitment efforts to attract new students.

Academics

  • Deliver one-on-one academic support and interventions to facilitate student learning and complement the work of center professionals.
  • Collaborate closely with the student support team to track learning pathways, monitor behavior, and implement transition plans, including incentive programs to bolster student achievement.
  • Partner with team members to problem-solve student challenges and improve engagement outcomes
  • Engage in professional development activities to enhance academic support practices.

Advocacy

  • Advocate for students by assisting in identifying solutions and connecting them to academy staff for academic and non-academic support.

Operations

  • Provide daily operational support for the academy,
  • Participate actively in academy meetings and school or community events.
  • Support home visits and local travel, as needed, to re-engage students
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support the overall mission of the academy.

What We’re Looking For

Education: Associate degree preferred, but equivalent experience in education, youth mentorship, or case management will be considered.
Experience: 0-2 years of relevant experience in educational support, case management, or working with at-risk youth.
Skills: Strong relationship-building, excellent communication, adaptability, and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.
Passion: A genuine commitment to supporting students who have disengaged from traditional schooling and a drive to help them succeed.
Technology: Proficiency with learning management systems and educational technology tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual skills (Spanish preferred!)
  • Experience in non-traditional educational settings.
  • Comfort with project-based and competency-based learning approaches.

Why Join Us?

Being part of Acceleration Academies means joining a team that’s dedicated to transforming student outcomes. Here, you’ll directly impact students’ lives, championing their growth, resilience, and path to graduation.

We Value Our Team’s Well-being

We prioritize the holistic well-being of our team members and their families through comprehensive benefits:

Competitive Compensation: Starting at $18.00 an hour

Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with up to a 4% company match to help secure your future.

Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, Company Paid Life Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance options are available to protect you and your loved ones.

Flexible Paid Time Off: Encouraging a healthy work-life balance through adaptable FTO.

Wellness Support: Employer-paid financial wellness programs and access to mental health resources.

Employee Referral Incentives: Rewarding you for helping us build a talented team.

Professional Development: Certification reimbursement programs to invest in your growth.

Bonus Opportunities: Celebrating milestones and achievements with performance-based bonuses.

Physical & Work Environment

  • Regularly required to sit, talk, hear, and use hands
  • Occasionally lift up to 20 pounds
  • Work in a collaborative classroom or office setting and may involve exposure to outdoor weather during events
  • Occasional travel between nearby academy sites may be required to support student needs or operational coverage

Ready to Make a Difference?
If you’re passionate about making a meaningful impact and shaping the future of education, we’d love to hear from you. Join us in redefining what’s possible for students everywhere.

title: Senior Application Packager
description:
Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Application Packager to support enterprise software packaging, deployment, and lifecycle management initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Endpoint Management technologies, application packaging tools, scripting, and software deployment best practices in large enterprise environments.

Key Responsibilities
Design, build, test, and deploy enterprise application packages for Windows environments.
Create and maintain complex Microsoft Windows Installer packages (MSI/MST) following enterprise standards and best practices.
Manage enterprise-wide software deployment strategies utilizing Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
Package and deploy COTS, GOTS, and custom-developed applications using:
- AdminStudio
- InstallShield
- PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit (PSADT) Build silent installation packages in MSI/MST format for automated enterprise deployments.
Perform application discovery and collaborate with developers, business stakeholders, and requestors to gather requirements, settings, and deployment preferences.
Deliver accurate package completion estimates and provide ongoing status reporting throughout the packaging lifecycle.
Prepare, build, update, and maintain clean virtual machine environments for application packaging and testing.
Automate packaging environments, including tool configuration, merge modules, and enterprise-wide settings.
Create conflict-free, validated, rollback-enabled, advertised, just-in-time, and error-free application packages for deployment through SCCM/MECM.
Develop and maintain scripts using:
- PowerShell
- VBScript
- CScript
- WScript
Support ad hoc application packaging requests and troubleshoot deployment-related issues.
Partner with Change Advisory Board (CAB) and User Engagement teams to ensure successful software deployments.
Follow established Change Management and Release Management processes, including maintenance planning and scheduling.
Support software deployments, updates, service packs, and emergency security patches.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues affecting the Microsoft production environment.
Continuously improve deployment processes through automation and scripting.

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 5 years of experience in Application Packaging and Software Deployment.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SCCM/MECM and Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
Extensive experience creating and managing MSI/MST packages in enterprise environments.
Expertise with AdminStudio, InstallShield, and/or PowerShell App Deployment Toolkit.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, VBScript, CScript, and WScript.
Experience managing the complete software deployment lifecycle.
Experience building and maintaining virtual packaging environments.
Strong understanding of software deployment methodologies, change management, and release management processes.
Ability to troubleshoot complex application deployment and packaging issues.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively on cross-functional teams.
Highly motivated, self-directed, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills (Not Mandatory)
Experience with Microsoft Intune and modern device/application management.
Knowledge of Windows Autopilot and endpoint provisioning processes.
Experience with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) administration and integration.
Familiarity with Microsoft App-V or application virtualization technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise environments within highly regulated industries and ITIL-based service management frameworks
