title: Department Supervisor - Tanger Outlets Myrtle Beach
description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

  • You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
  • Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
  • Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
  • Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
  • Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
  • Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
  • Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way


Fashion & Trend Awareness

  • Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
  • Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions


Team & Development

  • Retain and share your knowledge and skills with the Store team
  • Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
  • Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
  • Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
  • Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed


Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

  • Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
  • Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
  • Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
  • Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
  • Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
  • Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
  • Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
  • Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

  • To be a successful and effective Department Supervisor, you’ll be an emerging leader who enjoys taking responsibility.
  • You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
  • You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.


Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
  • You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
  • You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $17.05-$19.86 hourly**
EEOC Code: SLS
Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly


*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

Our company is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we actively seek colleagues who share our commitment.

title: Arbetsterapeut till funktionshinderverksamhet, kommunal hälso- och sjukvård
description:
Sociala omsorgsförvaltningen i Borås Stad ansvarar för kommunens funktionshinderverksamhet, socialpsykiatri samt hälso- och sjukvårdsinsatser för de nämnda målgrupperna. Med cirka 1000 anställda och 45 chefer arbetar vi kontinuerligt med att förbättra kvaliteten på våra tjänster för dem vi finns till för.

Ansökan

Din ansökan med bifogade dokument skickar du via vår ansökningsfunktion som du når via knappen Sök jobbet nedan.

Om du har skyddade personuppgifter, ska du inte skicka in din ansökan här. Kontakta istället rekryterande chef. Kontaktuppgifter finns i annonsen. Ange inte heller referenser med skyddad identitet.

Observera att ansökningar blir allmän handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen.

Om verksamheten

Vi söker dig som är arbetsterapeut och vill arbeta lösningsfokuserat, kreativt och tillsammans med ett tryggt team i den kommunala hälso- och sjukvården med inriktning mot funktionshinderverksamhet.

Du kommer att vara en del av ett av våra tre team och utgå från Bryggaregatan i Borås men arbeta i ett avgränsat geografiskt område där du möter personer som bor på gruppbostad, servicebostad eller ordinärt boende samt deltagare på daglig verksamhet.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som arbetsterapeut arbetar du med att stärka individens förmåga att klara sin vardag - det innebär att du arbetar preventivt, kompenserande och alltid med individens behov i fokus. Du har tillgång till beprövade metoder och strukturer, men vi vet också att det krävs mod att tänka nytt och kreativt. Vår målgrupp är komplex, vilket gör att flexibilitet, lyhördhet och förmåga att tänka utanför boxen är viktiga egenskaper i det dagliga arbetet.

Du arbetar tätt tillsammans med fysioterapeut, sjuksköterska, undersköterska och rehabassistent i ett tvärprofessionellt team där vi hjälps åt och kompletterar varandra. Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du trivs i samarbete med andra men också har förmågan att arbeta självständigt.

Som en extra förmån erbjuder vi dig fyra timmar per vecka som du fritt kan disponera för hemarbete, vilket ger en god balans mellan struktur och frihet.

Kvalifikationer

Vi letar efter dig som är legitimerad arbetsterapeut och som gärna har erfarenhet av att arbeta med personer med funktionsnedsättning. Det viktigaste är dock att du är engagerad, nyfiken och trygg i din roll, och att du har viljan att bidra till att förbättra vardagen för människor med olika funktionsvariationer.

Det här är en otroligt meningsfull roll där du får använda både din kompetens och din kreativitet. Om du letar efter ett arbete där ingen dag är den andra lik, där teamkänslan är stark och där du får växa både professionellt och personligt - då har du hittat rätt.

Körkort B är ett krav för tjänsten.

Övrig information

Här kan du läsa om dina förmåner som anställd i Borås Stad.

Innan erbjudande om anställning behöver ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister uppvisas.

title: Product Management Senior Advisor - Express Scripts - Hybrid
description:
Product Management Senior Advisor - Medicaid Encounter Operations

Make an Impact on Healthcare Outcomes

Are you a problem solver who enjoys turning complex data into meaningful results? As a Product Management Senior Advisor, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate and timely Medicaid encounter submissions that support state compliance requirements and client expectations. In this role, you will partner across teams, influence process improvements, and provide trusted expertise that helps drive operational excellence. If you are energized by collaboration, continuous improvement, and making a measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the success of Medicaid encounter operations by monitoring submission processes, identifying risks, and ensuring accurate and compliant file delivery to states and clients.
  • Analyze trends, performance metrics, and operational data to identify opportunities for improvement and recommend solutions that strengthen outcomes.
  • Investigate encounter rejections, perform root cause analysis, and lead remediation efforts in alignment with state guidance and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate data and findings into actionable recommendations that support leadership decision-making and business priorities.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve processes, enhance operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain business documentation that supports compliance monitoring, process execution, and communication of client impacts.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Medicaid encounter processes, providing guidance and education to internal stakeholders, account teams, and clients.
  • Build strong client and partner relationships by delivering clear updates, addressing questions, resolving issues, and managing expectations through timely follow-up.
  • Support client and state-facing discussions by communicating process status, performance results, and ongoing improvement efforts.
  • Contribute to achieving performance goals, compliance metrics, and service commitments while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in business analysis, healthcare operations, compliance, product management support, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, uncover root causes, and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, and validating data from multiple systems and sources.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions and influence outcomes through collaboration.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting information to diverse audiences.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service and operational excellence.
  • Ability to balance detailed execution while supporting broader strategic objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the pharmacy benefit management (PBM), healthcare, managed care, or health services industry.
  • Experience supporting Medicaid programs, encounter operations, claims processing, or healthcare compliance activities.
  • Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations.
  • Experience working directly with clients, account teams, or external stakeholders.
  • Experience using Tableau, SQL, or other reporting and data visualization tools.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading process improvement initiatives and driving operational efficiencies.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and embraces continuous learning and growth.


If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

title: Mobile Developer
description:
emergiTEL is hiring a Mobile Developer for our client in the Digital identity industry. This is a Permanent role.
Compensation: $100,000 - $120,000/year
Location: Toronto, ON
Job Description (English)
Role Overview
  • The Mobile Developer owns the native iOS and Android SDKs that partners embed in their own applications, serving as the client-side entry point to identity and fraud-prevention services, including SIM-based authentication aligned with GSMA standards.
  • This is SDK engineering rather than app engineering. The deliverable is a small, stable, well-documented library that other developers integrate once and depend on for years.
  • The role covers the full product surface, including public API design, deep platform and mobile-networking work, packaging and release, reference applications, and integration documentation.
  • Because the SDKs run inside banking and fintech applications, correctness, backward compatibility, binary footprint, and privacy are treated as first-class requirements.
What You’ll Do
  • Own the design, development, testing, and release of the native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) SDKs end to end.
  • Design public SDK interfaces that are small, hard to misuse, and stable across releases, with deliberate versioning, deprecation, and backward-compatibility practices.
  • Handle the realities of mobile networks, including Wi-Fi and cellular transitions, dual-SIM and eSIM devices, captive portals, carrier variation, timeouts, and retry behaviour.
  • Keep the SDK lightweight and dependency-light by minimizing binary footprint, avoiding transitive dependency conflicts inside host applications, and collecting no more data than an integration requires.
  • Build and maintain reference applications and sample integrations for both platforms that demonstrate real, production-shaped integration paths.
  • Write and own developer-facing documentation, including integration guides, API references, migration notes, and troubleshooting runbooks.
  • Own SDK distribution and release engineering, including Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods, XCFramework, Maven Central/Gradle, signed artifacts, changelogs, and reproducible CI builds.
  • Define a test strategy appropriate to code that cannot be hot-fixed in production, including unit tests, instrumented and device-farm testing across OS versions and device models, and simulated carrier conditions.
  • Support partner integration teams by triaging integration issues, reproducing customer-reported failures from logs, and feeding that feedback into API and documentation improvements.
  • Instrument the SDK for diagnostics and error reporting that helps partners debug quickly without exposing end-user data.
  • Track iOS and Android platform releases and proactively address breaking changes in permissions, privacy manifests, and network stack behaviour.
  • Partner with Backend, QA, and Security teams on service contracts, test coverage, and security reviews surrounding the SDK.
  • Actively participate in agile ceremonies as part of a Scrum team, helping drive feature delivery and platform modernization.
What You Bring
Must-Have Skills & Experience
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional mobile development experience.
  • Experience building and shipping SDKs or libraries consumed by third-party developers is a strong asset.
  • Current, hands-on production experience on both platforms: Swift for iOS and Kotlin for Android.
  • Proven public API design skills, including interface design, semantic versioning, deprecation strategy, thread-safety guarantees, and clear error-handling contracts.
  • Strong understanding of mobile networking, including HTTP/TLS, certificate handling, connection lifecycle, radio and Wi-Fi transitions, and behavior under unreliable network conditions.
  • Experience packaging and distributing libraries using Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods, XCFramework, Maven Central/AAR, including artifact signing and release processes.
  • Strong asynchronous and concurrency skills using Swift Concurrency/GCD and Kotlin Coroutines.
  • Solid automated testing discipline for library code, including mocking network layers and testing across OS versions and device configurations.
  • Proficiency with Git and CI/CD tools for mobile development such as Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, or similar.
  • Security-conscious mindset with experience in secure storage (Keychain, Android Keystore), certificate pinning, code obfuscation, and careful handling of personal information.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce integration documentation that partner developers can follow without requiring support.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to compatibility and edge cases.
What Sets You Apart
  • Prior experience at a vendor shipping SDKs into regulated customer environments such as banks, fintechs, or insurers, including security review, penetration testing, and SBOM processes.
  • Familiarity with device attestation and anti-fraud signals, including App Attest, DeviceCheck, Play Integrity, and root/jailbreak or emulator detection.
  • Experience wrapping native SDKs for cross-platform frameworks such as React Native, Flutter, or Cordova.
  • Hands-on use of device farms such as Firebase Test Lab, BrowserStack, or AWS Device Farm, and testing against real carrier SIMs.
  • Backend familiarity with Python, Java, and REST API design sufficient to help shape the service contracts consumed by the SDK.
  • Experience with mobile observability and crash reporting at scale.
  • Contributions to open-source mobile libraries, public technical writing, or developer advocacy.
Ideal Candidate
  • Has shipped code that other developers depend on and demonstrates excellent SDK design principles with small, intuitive, and reliable interfaces.
  • Equally comfortable working in Swift and Kotlin.
  • Interested in understanding mobile networking behaviour at a deep level.
  • Treats unclear integration documentation as a product quality issue and continuously improves developer experience.
  • Balances platform expertise, technical rigor, reliability, security, and usability in every release.
Vacancy Status / Statut du poste
This is an active position currently open for hiring. / Ce poste est activement ouvert au recrutement.
Use of Artificial Intelligence / Utilisation de l'intelligence artificielle
No artificial intelligence (AI) is used in the screening or selection process. All applications are reviewed by our recruitment team.

title: Member Specialist II
description:
Job Opening: Member Specialist II

Join Greenville Federal Credit Union as a Member Specialist II, where you'll be the vital link between our members and their financial success. This dynamic role invites you to engage with a diverse community, providing tailored solutions that empower individuals to achieve their financial goals. Here, you can enjoy a rewarding career while making a tangible difference in the lives of our members. As a Member Specialist II, you will build lasting relationships, gain valuable industry knowledge, and become part of a supportive team committed to excellence.

The excitement lies in the opportunity to grow professionally in a welcoming environment that values innovation and community. Embrace this chance to advance your career while making a positive impact in Greenville!

As we prepare to expand into the Berea community and continue our commitment to serving our members, we are offering premium compensation for bilingual candidates. If you are fluent in both English and Spanish, we encourage you to apply and help us provide exceptional service to our members. This is an especially exciting time to become part of our growing team.

Apply today and take the first step toward a rewarding career with us.

DAY TO DAY AS A MEMBER SPECIALIST

As a Member Specialist II at Greenville Federal Credit Union, you will play a crucial role in enhancing member satisfaction by actively listening to their financial needs and recommending tailored products and services. Your commitment to superior member service will shine as you manage accounts, resolve complex issues, and ensure timely resolutions. You'll leverage your comprehensive knowledge of credit union offerings to promote valuable options while achieving or exceeding sales and loan goals.

In this dynamic position, you will open and maintain various accounts, execute precise loan processes, and uphold compliance standards. Your attention to detail will ensure accuracy in all transactions, from account maintenance to coin machine balancing. Additionally, you will proactively identify potential fraud and manage member inquiries effectively.

This role is a perfect fit for those passionate about providing exceptional service while contributing to the financial well-being of the community.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR IN A MEMBER SPECIALIST

To thrive as a Member Specialist II at Greenville Federal Credit Union, you will need a combination of education and experience. A minimum of a high school diploma or GED required, along with at least one year of related sales experience and a foundational understanding of lending practices, credit reports, and loan policies. Strong verbal and communication skills are crucial for effectively cross-selling products and demonstrating the benefits of the credit union's offerings to members. Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and Outlook is required to manage daily tasks effectively. Additionally, candidates must be eligible and able to register with the National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry, ensuring compliance with industry standards. A commitment to providing outstanding service and a proactive approach to identifying members' financial needs will set you apart in this role.

Overall, the right candidate will embody a passion for helping others and a keen ability to navigate the complexities of member relations and financial products.

A LITTLE ABOUT US

Greenville Federal Credit Union offers a competitive benefits package, including generous PTO, holiday pay, on-demand pay, affordable medical and dental plans, a wide array of ancillary insurance products, a competitive 401-k plan with a generous match, and a friendly work environment that emphasizes service excellence.

Greenville Federal Credit Union is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Education and Community Engagement Officer - part time
description:
Help us make a difference as a Education and Community Engagement Officer.

This is a 24-hour per week part-time role, with flexible working arrangements available across Monday to Friday.

Hours can be worked over three full days (e.g. 8 hours per day) or spread across five shorter days, depending on preference and agreement.

The salary is up to £20,000 per annum (based on 24 hours per week).

A quick look at the role.

The Education and Community Engagement Officer plays a key role in building and maintaining positive relationships with local stakeholders, community groups, schools, subcontractors and residents as part of the Materials Resource Management (MRM) contract. The role focuses on proactive community engagement, education, transparency, and promoting awareness of waste management, recycling, and sustainability initiatives. A key element of the position is delivering engaging site visits and community outreach activities, including school tours and open days, ensuring they are safe, informative, and impactful.

Your core responsibilities

  • Deliver marketing, communications and engagement activity in line with agreed plans, working closely with site management and evaluating effectiveness of campaigns.
  • Develop and deliver awareness campaigns and community events to promote recycling, waste reduction, and sustainable behaviours, building strong local partnerships.
  • Organise and deliver educational programmes for schools and community groups in line with the National Curriculum and wider engagement objectives.
  • Plan, manage and host site visits, open days and tours, ensuring activities are safe, engaging, and well-coordinated, including the creation of supporting materials.
  • Act as the first point of contact for community enquiries and complaints, ensuring timely and professional responses, and maintaining accurate communications channels, including the website.
  • Represent the service at stakeholder meetings and lead external communications to strengthen the profile and reputation of the site within the local community.

Our essential requirements

  • Previous employment experience in a relevant industrial or commercial environment.
  • Good understanding of environmental issues and waste management practices.
  • Knowledge of relevant environmental legislation and compliance requirements.
  • Experience and understanding of social media platforms and their use for communication and engagement purposes.
  • Willingness to undergo a CRB (DBS) disclosure check and undertake some evening working.

And here’s why you’ll love it at Biffa.

  • Competitive salary
  • Ongoing career development, training and coaching – Because if you don’t grow, we don’t grow.
  • Generous pension scheme.
  • Retail and leisure discounts.
  • Holiday and travel discounts.
  • Life cover.

Changing the way people think about waste.

At Biffa, we love working with waste. Whether we’re turning it into sustainable power, finding new ways to recycle it or simply keeping it off the streets, we believe every day is an opportunity to improve the lives of millions. It’s a view that’s shared by our 11,000+ colleagues around the country, who trust us to provide them with a career that’s always rewarding, often challenging, but never dull.

Dedicated to diversity.

Being inclusive is core to our culture at Biffa; we believe different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds are key to developing a creative and effective working environment that represents our communities and generates the best outcomes for colleagues, customers and stakeholders, which is why you’ll find us championing diversity, equity and inclusion at every turn.

title: Vi söker behovsanställda - Krav på 50% sysselsättning
description:
Är du flexibel, gillar fysiskt arbete och vill jobba extra? Vi söker nu behovsanställda konsulter som kan hoppa in vid behov hos våra kunder. Uppdragen kan dyka upp med kort varsel, vilket gör tjänsten perfekt för dig som har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50 % och vill arbeta extra.

Arbetstiderna varierar beroende på uppdrag, så vi ser gärna att du är flexibel och har möjlighet att arbeta olika tider.

Om rollen Som behovsanställd konsult arbetar du ute hos olika kunder där arbetsuppgifterna kan variera från dag till dag. Det är ett omväxlande arbete där du snabbt behöver kunna anpassa dig till nya arbetsplatser och arbetsuppgifter.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter kan vara:

  • Containerlossning

  • Truckkörning

  • Orderplock och lagerarbete

  • Däcksortering

  • Sortering och hantering av inkommande och utgående gods

Arbetet kan stundtals vara fysiskt krävande och innebära ett högt tempo.

Vem söker vi? För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är en person som gillar att arbeta praktiskt och är flexibel när det gäller arbetsuppgifter och arbetsplatser. Du är ansvarstagande, punktlig och har lätt för att samarbeta med nya kollegor.

Vi ser gärna att du:

  • Är noggrann och effektiv i ditt arbete

  • Trivs i ett högt arbetstempo

  • Har god fysik och är van vid fysiskt arbete

  • Är flexibel och kan hoppa in med kort varsel

Krav

  • Annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50 % (studier eller annat arbete)

Meriterande

  • Truckkort

  • B-körkort och tillgång till bil

  • Erfarenhet från lager, logistik eller liknande arbete

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din inställning och arbetsvilja. Har du rätt motivation och vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss finns goda möjligheter till varierande uppdrag hos våra kunder.

Rekryteringsprocess och ansökan

Under rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll gällande brottmål. Du får själv ta del av resultatet och helt frivilligt att delge det med rekryterare. Mer information ges under processens gång.

Om Boxflow

Boxflow är ett av Sveriges snabbast växande logistikbolag och erbjuder tjänster inom tredjepartslogistik, sitelösningar, konsulttjänster samt bemanning av personal inom logistik och industri. Boxflow har verksamhet i Halmstad, Göteborg, Stockholm, Västerås Helsingborg, Malmö, Kristianstad och Perstorp.

Inom de närmsta åren beräknas Boxflow omsätta 1 miljard kronor och ha fler än 1100 anställda. Genom nära och långsiktiga samarbeten skapar Boxflow förutsättningar för hållbara och kostnadseffektiva logistiklösningar. Boxflows vision är att bli Norra Europas ledande logistikföretag.

description:

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend Full Stack - Emerging Products
description:
About the role:

Rippling’s Emerging Products teams which span Core Experience, Spend, and IT Products build deeply integrated systems across financial operations, IT administration, employee lifecycle automation, and enterprise security. These are high-trust product areas where reliability, correctness, security, and scale are critical.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data.

This role also supports Rippling’s expansion of AI-powered workflows across HR, IT, Finance, Spend, and core platform experiences. You’ll help make AI capabilities safe, reliable, explainable, auditable, and enterprise-ready, while ensuring customers have the trust, transparency, and control needed to adopt automation at scale.

What you will do:

  • Develop and improve both product backend capabilities and user-facing features, working across the stack to make them shine
  • Own the design and implementation of backend services and APIs that power critical product capabilities.
  • Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems for high-volume workflows across Spend, IT, identity, access, approvals, and compliance.
  • Translate ambiguous business and customer needs into robust technical solutions in partnership with product, frontend, platform, design, and cross-functional teams.
  • Build and evolve systems involving workflows, permissions, policy enforcement, financial operations, device and app management, procurement, and security controls.
  • Raise the technical bar through system design, code reviews, design reviews, mentorship, and backend engineering best practices.
  • Help create unified product experiences that replace fragmented point solutions for managing employees, spend, devices, apps, access, and business operations.

What you will need:

  • 5+ years of experience in a production environment using Python, Django, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity in frontend development with React or typescript.
  • Exposure and hands on experience with systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale
  • Strong product intuition: you care about design and user experience and are quick to identify how these could be improved.
  • Experience shipping complex projects
  • Deep understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals
  • Strong communication skills with a variety of stakeholders


Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com


Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.


This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.


A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

title: People Generalist
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a People Generalist (Sales Market), your main focus will be to support the full people agenda by executing people processes, assisting employees and managers, and ensuring smooth recruitment, onboarding, development, and engagement activities.

You use people data and insights to guide actions, coordinate initiatives, and help create a fair, compliant, and supportive working environment.

This hybrid role reports into our People Manager and is based out of our Toronto Support Office.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

People Processes, Employee Support & Relations

  • People Processes Implementation: Execute or support the employee life-cycle processes as per indication of group agreed processes
  • People Initiatives Coordination: Coordinate and execute people initiatives or projects affecting the business units supported or function belonging
  • Support Business Units: Support employees or managers when applicable while implementing people processes, initiatives or solutions affecting the business unit or function
  • Employee and Labour Relations: Provide support in addressing employee inquiries, concerns, and basic employee relations matters. Also support on union negotiations if applicable
  • Employee Engagement Initiatives: Support employee engagement initiatives and activities to enhance workplace satisfaction and productivity
  • Talent, Recruitment & Development
  • Ensure high‑quality recruitment by securing consistent hiring processes, including clear communication, guidelines, deadlines, and full management of Assessment Centers
  • Support onboarding delivery and follow‑up for Store Management teams
  • Training organization, facilitation, and quality follow‑up (incl. culture & values)
  • Support Performance management and development follow‑up (dialogs, contribution journeys)
  • Succession planning and talent pipeline management for Department Managers & Sales Advisor

Data & Insights

  • Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze people metrics and data to provide insights for decision-making and report on key performance indicators relevant to business units
  • You prepare and follow up on people data reports, including headcount, turnover, training metrics, and hiring follow‑up
  • Explicit people KPI follow‑up linked to fair working environment outcomes

We are looking for people with...

  • Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
  • Experience in HR operations or generalist HR role
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills with attention to detail
  • Good understanding of HR processes and employee lifecycle management
  • Ability to analyze data and produce accurate HR reports
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Commitment to collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement

​WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
  • You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
  • You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, and COS

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

Compensation: annual salary is $97,200 **

H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

title: Julextra till Åhléns Katrineholm
description:
Om din roll

Vårt mål på Åhléns är att vara upplevelsedriven destination som gör skillnad för kunden. Som säljare julextra hos oss har du en nyckelroll i att göra detta till verklighet. Ditt uppdrag är att bidra till försäljningen genom aktiv kundkontakt. Du möter människor varje dag och är med och skapar en kundupplevelse som gör skillnad och överträffar förväntningar.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • Att sälja genom aktiv kundkontakt i enlighet med Åhléns servicekoncept

  • Att aktivt arbeta med merförsäljning genom tävlingar och kampanjer

  • Säkerställa en inspirerande och säljande varuhusmiljö som skapar den bästa kundupplevelsen

  • Säkerställa att lager och varuhus är välfyllt samt se till att det ser fint ut på säljytorna

Du blir en del av ett passionerat team och jobbar nära övriga roller i varuhuset, vilket till exempel kan vara Visual Merchandiser, Säljledare samt Varuhuschef.

Vi erbjuder dig:

Åhléns har funnits i många svenska hjärtan i över 120 år. Med en lång historia inom detaljhandeln fortsätter vi drivas av ständig utveckling. Hos oss får du vara med på en spännande resa där vi kombinerar vår historia med innovation och nya arbetssätt för att skapa en lönsam och hållbar framtid.

Till oss tar du med dig:

  • Arbetslivserfarenhet från försäljning/service, gärna inom detaljhandeln

  • En brinnande passion för god kundservice

  • Ett intresse för trender och vårt sortiment

  • Bra energi och ett gott tempo eftersom vi behöver vara snabbfotade

För att lyckas i rollen som säljare julextra och trivas på Åhléns tror vi att du brinner för försäljning lika mycket som vi och har en hög service-känsla. Du tycker om att arbeta i team och att uppnå resultat genom samarbete. Du är flexibel och trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo. Du är nyfiken på kunden och delar med dig av dina kunskaper och idéer.

Åhléns är en organisation i högt tempo, där mycket händer. Med dig i laget blir vi ännu ännu bättre!

Om rekryteringen

Vi söker julextra med varierande timmar/veckan beroende på hur mycket stöd vi behöver i verksamheten under jul. Möjlighet att fortsätta jobba hos oss efter årsskiftet vid överenskommelse. Du arbetar enligt schema som sträcker sig över vardagar, kvällar och helger. Arbetstiderna kan variera mellan kl 08-18. Vi ser gärna att du kan börja hos oss redan i september/oktober för introduktion.

Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Som Säljare på Åhléns blir du en del av ett passionerat team som drivs av affärsmanskap och entreprenörskap. Vi ger dig förtroende och möjligheten att växa i en utvecklande miljö. Med det hälsar vi dig varmt välkommen till Åhléns!

title: AI Engineer - Internship
description:
Job Description

Reporting directly to the Director of Engineering, your responsibilities will include (but not limited to):

  • Deliver AI powered solutions driving both internal efficiencies and new customer value through data insights
  • AI/ML Solution Implementation: Work closely with business leaders and data scientists to understand user needs and transition AI/ML prototypes into production-ready solutions
  • Full-Scale Model Deployment: Design, develop, and deploy scalable machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex business problems.

Do you have the skills and attitude we’re looking for? We are seeking motivated candidates with:

  • Genuine interest in consumer goods, supply chain, quality control, or operations—a plus
  • Strong IT skills and comfort using digital tools/platforms
  • The ability to thrive under pressure in a fast-paced work environment
  • Proactive mindset, eagerness to learn, and readiness to take on new challenges
  • A genuine enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and its practical applications in operations, quality control, or client management; experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and decision-making is a strong plus.

Why Join QIMA?

  • Be part of a globally recognized leader in quality assurance with a vibrant, multicultural workforce
  • Gain hands-on experience in operations, management, and process improvement
  • Develop your professional skills and grow your network within the supply chain industry
  • Contribute to impactful projects and help shape QIMA’s operational excellence

If you are a motivated student or fresh graduate excited to kickstart your career in supply chain and operations, apply now with your CV in English. Join QIMA and help us create a high-performing team dedicated to excellence!

title: CNC Operatör till Life Science-företag i Umeå
description:
Har du CNC-kunskap, drivkraft och en vilja att utvecklas i ett engagerat och positivt team där precision, kvalitet och ständiga förbättringar står i fokus?

Då kan du vara den vi söker!


Academic Resource söker nu en CNC-Operatör till ett Life Science-företag i Umeå.

Tjänsten är ett konsultuppdrag fram till årsskiftet initialt men med möjlighet till förlängning.

Arbetet är på heltid, 38 h/v och on-site. Placering i Umeå.

Arbetstidsform: 2-skift. Skifttider 05.54-14.24 måndag-fredag, 14.12-23.42 måndag-torsdag.

Start omgående.


Om rollen/arbetsuppgifter:

Som CNC-operatör i företagets mekaniska verkstad arbetar du i 2-skift med CNC-styrda svarvar och fräsar.

Du blir en viktig del av ett kompetent team som tillverkar högteknologiska detaljer i olika material så som PEEK, aluminium och titan.

Produkterna används i avancerade system för medicinsk forskning och tillverkning, vilket ställer höga krav på precision, kvalitet och noggrannhet.


Kvalifikationer:

• Utbildad CNC operatör gärna med några års erfarenhet

• Noggrann med starkt kundfokus

• Dokumenterade kunskaper i ritningsläsning, alternativt arbetslivserfarenhet

• Vilja att alltid bli bättre tillsammans med sina arbetskamrater genom att planera och nyttja maskinerna på bästa sätt


Om Academic Resource:

Academic Resource är rekryterings- och bemanningsföretaget för akademiker med erfarenhet.

Vi har lång erfarenhet av Uthyrning, Rekrytering samt Interim Management inom tjänstesektorn.

Våra affärsområden är Life Science, Ekonomi & Finans, samt HR. Vi verkar inom tjänstesektorn och främst i Stockholm & Uppsala.


Som konsult hos Academic Resource erbjuds du:

• Förmåner som t.ex. tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och föräldralön.

• Ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag vilket innebär en mycket större trygghet, då du omfattas av kollektivavtalens villkor för till exempel lön, försäkringar, pension och semester.

• En engagerad konsultchef som finns tillgänglig och håller löpande kontakt med dig och kundföretagen under hela din anställning som ser till att du trivs och utvecklas på din arbetsplats!

• Möjlighet att utvecklas genom lärande på arbete såväl som i varierade roller på intressanta kundföretag.


Ansökan:

Intervjuer och urval sker löpande, så ansök gärna så snart som möjligt.

Skicka in ditt CV och personliga brev i PDF eller Word format.

Klicka på Sök tjänsten och ange referens: CCO0826


Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta:

rekrytering.lifescience@academicresource.se


Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post.


We take you further!

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Job Summary

The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction by leading quality performance across the entire product value stream, from supplier through end customer. This role serves as the primary customer interface for all product‑related quality topics, proactively addressing concerns, driving root‑cause resolution, and ensuring customer requirements are clearly understood and met. The Senior Quality Engineer partners cross‑functionally to implement robust quality systems and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product reliability, operational performance, and customer confidence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead quality related APQP activities, including control plan, inspection methods, meeting AIAG and customer specific requirements, Supplier APQP, PPAP development and submission. Supports the divisional APQP process and requirements.

Skills

title: Deputy Director of Finance, Administration & Strategy - (Job Code 0951 Exempt) - San Francisco Arts Commission
description:
The Deputy Director of Finance, Administration, & Strategy serves as the executive responsible for the San Francisco Arts Commission’s administrative operations, financial stewardship, organizational performance, and strategic execution. This position ensures the agency has the systems, people, technology, and operational discipline necessary to deliver exceptional public service. The Deputy Director of Finance, Administration & Strategy reports to the Executive Director of Arts & Culture.

The Deputy Director oversees Finance, Human Resources, Information Technology, Administrative Services, Risk Management, Policy Administration, and Agency Performance. The position leads enterprise planning, organizational strategy, performance management, and data analytics to ensure the department's work aligns with City priorities and delivers measurable public value.

The Deputy Director supervises the Finance & Accounting manager, Contract Analyst, and Operations staff, and works closely with the Department of Human Resources, Controller's Office, Department of Technology, Mayor's Office, and other City partners. This position serves as a key member of the Executive Leadership Team and acts on behalf of the Executive Director when delegated.

Essential Duties
The duties specified below are representative of the range of duties assigned to this position and are not intended to be an inclusive list.

Financial Leadership

  • Direct the development and management of the agency's operating and capital budgets across multiple funding sources.
  • Ensure responsible stewardship of public resources through strong fiscal controls, forecasting, long-range financial planning, and transparent reporting.
  • Develop and/or update departmental financial policies to align with citywide standards, and in collaboration with program teams, establish internal processes for implementation.
  • Review and approve significant expenditures, contracts, grants, purchase orders, and capital transactions.
  • Prepare and present financial reports and recommendations to the Controller's Office, Mayor's Budget Office, Arts Commission, Capital Planning Committee, and executive leadership.

Strategy & Organizational Performance

  • Lead agency-wide strategic planning, implementation, and performance management.
  • Develop agency goals, key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and accountability measures to support continuous improvement.
  • Establish systems for measuring operational effectiveness, customer service, grantmaking outcomes, cultural impact, and organizational performance.
  • Build the agency's data and analytics capacity to support evidence-based decision making.
  • Produce executive performance reports and strategic analyses that inform policy and operational decisions.
  • Identify organizational risks and opportunities and recommend improvements based on data, customer feedback, and performance outcomes.
  • Lead strategic initiatives that modernize systems, improve service delivery, and strengthen public trust.

Administration & Operations

  • Direct Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, facilities, procurement, records management, administrative operations, and internal policy.
  • Partner with the Department of Human Resources on recruitment, workforce planning, employee engagement, labor relations, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Oversee workplace safety, facilities management, cybersecurity coordination, and continuity of operations.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and City policies.

Data & Technology

  • Establish agency-wide data governance and reporting standards.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of executive dashboards and performance reporting systems.
  • Expand the use of technology and business intelligence tools to improve agency operations, grantmaking, permitting, financial management, and customer experience.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, accessibility, and appropriate use in decision making.

Executive Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the Executive Director on financial, operational, and organizational matters.
  • Present financial, operational, and policy recommendations to the Arts Commission and executive leadership.
  • Coordinate agency-wide initiatives with other City departments and external partners.
  • Serve as Acting Executive Director when designated.

Performs other duties as assigned.

    Minimum Qualifications

    Education: Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university, AND

    Experience: Four (4) years of senior-level professional management experience, all of which must include supervisory experience of professional staff.

    Education Substitution: Up to two (2) years of additional qualifying experience may substitute for the required bachelor's degree.

    Note: One-year full-time employment is considered equivalent to 2000 hours (2000 hours of qualifying work experience is based on a 40-hour work week). Any overtime hours that you work above forty (40) hours per week are not included in the calculation to determine full-time employment.

    Desirable Qualifications
    The stated desirable qualifications may be used to identify job finalists at the end of the selection process when candidates are referred for hiring.

    • Demonstrated managerial experience in business administration, government administration, finance, operations, or a closely related field.
    • Experience in an arts, cultural, or public sector organization.
    • Experience leading strategic planning, organizational transformation, or enterprise performance initiatives.
    • Experience developing performance dashboards, data analytics, or organizational metrics.
    • Experience managing complex public budgets and multiple funding sources.
    • Experience presenting to governing boards, commissions, or elected officials.

    Verification of Education and Experience:
    Every application is reviewed to ensure that you meet the minimum qualifications as listed in the job ad. Review SF Careers Employment Applications for considerations taken when reviewing applications.

    Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process. If education verification is required, information on how to verify education requirements, including verifying foreign education credits or degree equivalency, can be found at .

    Note: Falsifying one’s education, training, or work experience or attempted deception on the application may result in disqualification for this and future job opportunities with the City and County of San Francisco.

    Supplemental Questionnaire: Ccandidates will be required to also complete a Supplemental Questionnaire as part of the employment application. The Supplemental Questionnaire is designed to obtain specific information regarding an applicant's experience in relation to the minimum qualifications for this position. These responses will be used to evaluate if the applicant possesses the required minimum qualifications. Within a few days of the City’s receipt of a candidate’s completed application, the Supplemental Questionnaire will be emailed to the candidate and it must be completed by the deadline stated therein. Late submissions will not be accepted.

    Selection Process: The selection process will include evaluation of applications in relation to the minimum qualifications. Applicants meeting the minimum qualifications are not guaranteed advancement through all of the steps in the selection process. Depending on the number of applicants, the Department may establish and implement additional screening mechanisms to comparatively evaluate the qualifications of candidates. If this becomes necessary, only those applicants whose qualifications most closely meet the needs of the Department will be invited for an interview.

    Additional Information Regarding Employment with the City and County of San Francisco:

    Where to Apply
    All job applications for the City and County of San Francisco must be submitted through our online portal. Please visit to begin your application process.

    Computers are available for the public (9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Monday through Friday) to file online applications in the lobby of the Dept. of Human Resources at 1 South Van Ness Avenue, 4th Floor and at the City Career Center at City Hall, 1 Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Place, Room 110.

Your first and last name must match your legal ID for verification, and preferred names can be included in parentheses. Use your personal email address, not a shared or work email, to avoid unfixable issues.

Applicants should retain this confirmation email for their records. Failure to receive this email means that the online application was not submitted or received. If you have any questions, you may contact Kelly Alves at kelly.k.alves@sfgov.org.

title: Epicor System Administrator
description:
Epicor System Administrator
Location: Illinois
Onsite Requirements: Fully Onsite
Compensation Range: Approximately $125,000 annually, based on experience
Benefits: Traditional 401(k) and Roth 401(k) with company match, Medical, Dental & Vision, ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan), Company-Paid Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability, 15 Days PTO, 11 Paid Holidays
Introduction
Our client, a well-established manufacturing organization, is seeking an experienced Epicor System Administrator to take ownership of the technical health, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability of its Epicor ERP environment.
This is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role within a small IT team, reporting to the VP of Information Systems. The ideal candidate will bring strong Epicor administration and development experience and enjoy working closely with Manufacturing, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and other functional teams.
The organization has been running Epicor for 15+ years and currently operates Epicor ERP 10 in an on-premises environment. This is an opportunity to become a key technical resource for a critical enterprise system while helping shape its long-term architecture, supportability, security, and performance.
U.S. Citizenship is required due to ITAR regulations.
Day-to-Day Responsibilities
  • Administer and maintain Epicor environments, including application servers, task agents, application pools, schedulers, background processes, and related services.
  • Manage Epicor user security, including user access, security groups, menu permissions, field-level security, plant/site permissions, functional roles, and segregation-of-duties controls.
  • Plan, test, document, and execute Epicor upgrades, patches, hotfixes, environment refreshes, and deployments across development, test, and production environments.
  • Develop and maintain Epicor solutions including BAQs, BPMs, Method Directives, Data Directives, Dashboards, SSRS Reports, integrations, and approved customizations.
  • Support SQL Server performance and reliability through query analysis, troubleshooting, performance tuning, data investigation, and coordination of backup/recovery activities.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, logs, scheduled processes, interfaces, and integrations while diagnosing and resolving technical issues.
  • Automate repetitive administrative and support tasks using PowerShell, SQL, Epicor tools, APIs, and other approved technologies.
  • Provide advanced technical support and root-cause analysis for Epicor-related issues.
  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation covering environments, configurations, security, integrations, customizations, recovery procedures, and support processes.
  • Partner with functional teams to translate approved business requirements into secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with external vendors and support partners when necessary to resolve complex issues and implement system enhancements.
  • Advocate for standard Epicor functionality and sustainable solutions while minimizing unnecessary customization and long-term technical debt.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Must-have qualifications that candidates must meet to be considered.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Epicor ERP/Kinetic experience, including system administration in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated experience with Epicor environment administration, security, performance troubleshooting, upgrades, patches, and change control.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on Epicor development experience with BPMs, Method/Data Directives, BAQs, Dashboards, and SSRS Reports.
  • Strong SQL skills for complex data analysis, troubleshooting, and performance investigation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server administration and backup/recovery concepts.
  • Experience with C# and the Epicor data model for server-side business logic and approved custom solutions.
  • Strong Epicor customization and technical troubleshooting experience.
  • Ability to evaluate business requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to ITAR regulations.
Preferred Skills & Qualifications
Nice-to-have skills that would make a candidate more competitive but are not required.
  • Experience supporting Epicor within an integrated manufacturing environment.
  • Functional knowledge of Sales, Supply Chain, Production, Finance, MRP, BOM/MOM, Scheduling, Logistics, and Quality modules.
  • Experience with PowerShell, REST APIs, integrations, and automation.
  • Experience supporting secure, regulated, or audit-ready IT environments.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot complex ERP and business-process issues.
  • Experience coordinating technical projects, system deployments, or ERP-related initiatives.
  • Epicor certifications or other relevant technical certifications.

#LI-FR1

title: Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist till VB Energi
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

VB Energikoncernen är ett miljö- och arbetsmiljöcertifierat energiföretag med huvudkontor i Ludvika. Verksamheten med ca 85 anställda rymmer fjärrvärme, eldistribution och drift av vattenkraftstationer. Företagets huvudägare är Ludvika kommun och Fagersta kommun. Gå gärna in på vår hemsida vbenergi.se för ytterligare information.


Om rollen

Brinner du för att arbeta med miljö- och hållbarhet och vill vara med oss på resan mot en hållbar framtid? Just nu söker vi på VB Energi dig som vill kliva in i rollen som vår Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist på vårt huvudkontor i Ludvika.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en bred roll nära verksamheten, du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt tillsammans med chefer och övriga kollegor.

Vi letar efter dig som har djup kompetens inom miljö- och tillståndsfrågor och självständigt kan driva och företräda koncernen i dessa frågor, men även dig som trivs med att dela med dig av din kunskap för att utbilda och vidareutveckla vårt miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete.

Om rollen som Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist

I rollen som vår Miljö- och hållbarhetsspecialist kommer du arbeta brett med frågorna och du är den enda inom koncernen med denna expertis. Du arbetar nära arbetsmiljöspecialist, kvalitetsingenjör, chefer och övriga kollegor. Du sitter i staben och rapporterar direkt till VB Energis VD.

Du ansvarar för tillståndsfrågor, miljörapportering och tillsynsbesök. Du stöttar även personalen vid tolkning och utveckling av kontrollprogram samt målstyrning mot miljö och hållbarhet. Du bidrar med din kunskap i projekt och du håller dig uppdaterad kring gällande lagstiftning.

VB Energi har både elnät-, fjärrvärme- och entreprenadverksamhet, och du får kliva in och stötta inom alla verksamhetsområdena. I rollen kommer du även ha ansvar för att driva och samordna arbetet för vårt lokala vattenkraftbolag genom omprövningsprocessen inom den Nationella planen – från planering och utredning, via samverkan och myndighetsdialog, till framtagande och inlämning av ansökan om moderna miljövillkor till Mark- och miljödomstolen.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att innehålla:

  • Miljörapportering, tillståndshantering och myndighetsdialoger
  • Delta i samråd
  • Utbildning av kollegor
  • Utveckla koncernens miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete
  • Utredningar och utvecklingsprojekt
  • Säkerställa att ledningssystemet kopplat till miljö är uppdaterat
  • Administrera och dokumentera miljöarbete i enlighet med ISO 14001
  • Utveckling av vår kemikaliehantering i Ichemistry
  • Avvikelsehantering i ENIA
  • Utveckla och följa upp verksamhetens Egenkontrollprogram
  • Utveckla, och följa upp verksamhetens avfallshantering inkl farligt avfall och farligt gods
  • Utveckla, planera, genomföra och följa upp intern och externa revisoner

Du kommer att tillhöra en arbetsplats som präglas av engagemang, samarbete och öppenhet. Organisationen är liten och familjär, vilket skapar en stark gemenskap och högt i tak. Vi stöttar varandra och erbjuder en varierande vardag. Hos oss finns det goda möjligheter till utveckling och utbildning.


Kravspecifikation

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har minst fem års erfarenhet av brett och självständigt miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete. Du behöver kunna växla mellan praktiskt och administrativt arbete, och du behöver vara trygg i dig själv samt kunna prioritera det som är viktigast. Vidare är du noggrann och kommunikativ.

Vidare har du:

  • Arbetslivserfarenhet från miljö- och hållbarhetsarbete, gärna från energibranschen
  • Högskoleutbildning eller KY-utbildning inom miljö- och hållbarhet
  • Flytande svenska, i både tal och skrift, samt god förståelse för engelska krävs
  • God dator- och systemvana är ett krav då en stor del av arbetet görs i olika IT-system
  • Erfarenhet av ledningssystem, Internkontrollprogram och internrevision
  • Erfarenhet av miljö- och tillståndsprocesser, gärna inom fjärrvärme, elnät eller vattenkraft
  • Erfarenhet av dialog och samverkan med Länsstyrelsen, andra myndigheter, kommuner och övriga berörda aktörer
  • God förmåga att självständigt driva processer framåt, hålla ihop tidplaner och säkerställa att rätt underlag tas fram i rätt tid
  • God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att skapa förtroende och goda relationer med olika intressenter


Ytterligare information

Vi erbjuder

En möjlighet till att jobba i ett lokalt energibolag som arbetar tillsammans för en säker och stabil drift och därmed bidrar till att våra kunder får leverans av miljövänlig energi. Du får en varierande vardag med utmanande arbetsuppgifter, möjligheten att utveckla både dig själv och verksamheten genom att delta i olika projekt och arbeta med förbättringsåtgärder.

Det är viktigt att hela livet fungerar och därför är vi måna om att våra medarbetare upplever en god balans mellan arbete och fritid.

Placeringsort: Ludvika


För mer information om själva tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Johanna Walterson, johanna.walterson@vbenergi.se. . För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta rekryterare Kajsa Loman, kajsa.loman@vattenfall.com.


Fackliga representanter är Torbjörn Jonsson Unionen, Mikael Boström Sveriges Ingenjörer och Pertti Palonto SEKO. Du når dem genom växeln på 0240-876 00.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 18 september 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV.

Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. VB Elnät arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation.

title: Customer Solutions Specialist
description:
We are Rokt. We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We’ve built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.

The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation, which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability.

We are looking for an Customer Solutions Specialist

Target total compensation ranges from $67,000 - $74,500, including a fixed annual salary of $60,000 - $67,500, an employee equity plan grant, and world-class benefits. This is the expected range for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.

Equity grants are issued in good faith, subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.

About the Role:

AfterSell by Rokt is a dynamic team dedicated to empowering eCommerce merchants and driving success in the ever-evolving digital landscape.

As a Customer Solutions Specialist, you’ll play a key role in supporting our partners as they navigate the Aftersell application. Your primary responsibility will be to assist customers through live chat to support them in having the best experience using our product. This involves providing timely and accurate information, troubleshooting technical problems, addressing concerns or complaints in a professional and empathetic manner, and passing product feedback along to our RPD Teams. You’ll also be responsible for working on projects to help strengthen and empower the Support Team in the form of experimenting with review generation, partner onboarding, and more.

We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn’t obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won’t like it here.

How your future team uses AI:

  • Triage incoming live-chat conversations, helping route customers to the right person and prioritize urgent or complex issues.
  • Accelerate technical troubleshooting by helping the team investigate issues, identify potential causes, and validate solutions before responding.
  • Identify recurring support themes and develop scalable processes and automations to improve the customer experience.

Requirements

How You'll Contribute

  • Manage Support Tickets. You'll be working in Intercom to respond to live chat and email customer queries that come in.
  • Guide Our Customers. You’ll work with our customers to educate them on how to use our app to be most successful.
  • Address Customer Issues. While some tickets are fairly simple and straightforward, there may be more complex. You will work to find solutions to these problems and escalate for additional support when the situation calls for it.
  • Collect Customer Feedback. We are extremely customer centric and value every bit of feedback from our customers, whether it’s positive or negative.

title: Multi-Site HSE Officer  Data Centre
description:
About the Role

CodeSeason AB is seeking an experienced Multi-Site HSE Officer to support a major data centre construction project across multiple active sites in Sweden. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining and promoting the highest standards of health, safety, and environmental compliance across project locations in Eskilstuna, Katrineholm, and Västerås, with Eskilstuna serving as the base location.

Working closely with the QEHS Manager, Construction Managers, site teams, and subcontractors, you will help ensure a safe working environment while supporting the successful delivery of a high-profile infrastructure project.

Key Responsibilities

-Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly HSE inspections and audits.

-Review and develop Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS).

-Identify hazards and implement appropriate control measures.

-Support incident, accident, and near-miss investigations.

-Monitor and close out HSE non-conformities and corrective actions.

-Deliver toolbox talks, inductions, and refresher training.

-Participate in HSE meetings with employees, subcontractors, and management.

- Maintain accurate HSE documentation and reporting.

-Monitor safety observations, incidents, and trends.

-Promote positive safety culture and share best practices across sites.

-Travel regularly between project locations as required.


Qualifications and Experience

Essential Requirements

-BAS-P and BAS-U certification/training.

-2–4 years of relevant HSE experience.

-Strong construction health and safety experience.

-Good knowledge of Swedish health and safety legislation and regulations.

-Experience with RAMS, inspections, audits, and incident reporting.

-Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

-Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with site teams and subcontractors.

-Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook

-Full clean driving licence.

Desirable Qualifications • •

-Experience working on data centre projects or other mission-critical environments.

-NEBOSH International Diploma or equivalent qualification.

What We Offer

-Opportunity to work on a high-profile data centre infrastructure project.

-Exposure to multi-site operations across a major construction programme.

-Collaboration with experienced QEHS and construction management professionals.

-Valuable experience within Sweden’s rapidly growing data centre sector.

Location and Travel

The role is based in Eskilstuna, with regular travel required between project sites in Katrineholm, Eskilstuna, and Västerås.

Application

If you meet the above requirements and would like to contribute to a major construction project in Sweden, please submit your CV and relevant certifications for consideration.

CodeSeason AB is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.
