title: Project Manager II (Corpus Christi, TX)
description:
Salary Range: $116-145k/year + 15% bonus + LTIP $18,000


Our client is the premier infrastructure and logistics provider for the world's energy needs, both today and tomorrow. Since 1886, we have successfully navigated transitions in the way energy has been distributed to continually meet the needs of an evolving market and industry environment. Our people are a critical element to the success and longevity of our operational history and our future as we seek to thrive through the energy transition.
We own and operate a diversified global network of integrated assets providing midstream logistic solutions, primarily consisting of the transportation, storage, processing, and marketing of liquid petroleum products. We are committed to safely and responsibly providing world-class service to meet the continually evolving energy needs of our customers and the communities we serve. As part of this commitment to our customers, we are continually diversifying our platform and service offerings to enable less carbon intensive energy solutions and undertaking decarbonization efforts on our operations.

Our client is currently seeking a Project Manager II with experience managing pipeline and/or terminal projects in the Oil & Gas Industry to join our team!

Role Summary:
The Project Manager II role is responsible for providing project management services for pipeline, station, and terminal projects throughout the company

Responsibilities & Essential Functions include:

Size of Projects: $15,000 - $1.5 million
  • Project Initiating and Planning. Completing development of project scopes of work, cost estimates, schedules, work plans, and resource requirements as part of the initiation and planning phases of the project life cycle.
  • Project Implementation. Managing implementation (project design, engineering, purchasing/contracting, construction, startup and commissioning, and closing) of projects in the petroleum industry and developing current reports regarding Project Status and Cost Forecasting.
  • Project Approvals. Evaluating and obtaining approval of changes to project scopes of work, budgets, and/or schedules and completing all required documentation of changes
  • Lead or facilitate meetings and ensure, as appropriate, that minutes are documented and distributed.
  • Plan and organize system and facility downtime, startup and commissioning with Operations, Transportation, the Control Center, and other Functional Departments
  • Manages large projects with multiple technical disciplines. Manages and leads engineering providers for large scope and drawing creation.
  • Provide SME input to the district and Cooperate support staff.
  • Project Completion. Ensuring development of Construction and Operational Punch Lists and completion of all outstanding items and ensure completion of project documentation such as as-built drawings, operating manuals, PM's, equipment tagging, device settings, and Completion Certificates.
  • And other duties as assigned.

Position Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering required or PM Certification from Project Management Institute or 10 years of experience managing projects in the petroleum industry.
  • Experience and demonstrated aptitude in most phases of engineering, construction, and operations of pipeline, station, and terminal facilities.
  • Up to 30% travel

Certificates & Licenses:
  • Primavera Software - Advanced
  • EIT Certification and intentions to obtain or have obtained a PE license is desirable.
  • PM Certification from Project Management Institute is desirable.

Other Skills, Attributes and Abilities:
  • Demonstrated aptitude in some phases of engineering, construction, and operations of pipeline, station, and terminal facilities
  • Assist with development of special projects, as needed
  • Ability to manage outside Engineering firms

Essential Functions:
  • This position requires the ability to safely and successfully perform essential job functions consistent with ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards, including meeting qualitative and or/quantitative productivity standards.
  • This role requires the ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards.
  • This position requires compliance with all personnel policies.

Physical & Safety Requirements:
  • This role is regularly exposed to outside weather conditions.
  • This position requires the employee to regularly access and work at or around heights in excess of 5 feet, moving mechanical parts, moving on-track rail equipment, petroleum product or other chemical fumes, airborne particles like dust or other chemicals, vibration, uneven terrain, and high noise level in the work environment.
  • The person in this position needs to occasionally move inside the office to access file cabinets, office equipment, etc.
  • This role continuously operates a computer and other office productivity equipment (i.e. a calculator, copy machine and computer printer).
  • The incumbent in this role must wear Fire Retardant Clothing (FRC) and/or Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
  • The employee is frequently required to effectively communicate with others.
  • This position requires the ability to work comfortably and safely in the proximity to open water.
  • This position is subject to DOT drug and alcohol regulations

title: APC Operator, NBC Connecticut
description:
We are looking for an APC Operator to join the Operations team in West Hartford, CT supporting NBC Connecticut. As an APC Operator, you will be primarily responsible for directing and operating live and recorded television news productions using the Ross Overdrive Automated Production Control system. If you love the thrill of live production, enjoy working with people, and want to make a positive impact while being a part of a high performing team working with leading edge production technology, you could be the perfect match for our team.

Essential Functions

  • Technical preparation, coding and execution of live and recorded television news content and programming from production control rooms, studios and remote locations.
  • Give direction and timing to talent and other technicians during broadcasts and studio productions.
  • Shape overall creative appearance of the broadcast using imaginative video, audio and graphics presentations in concert with the Content team.
  • Operate video and graphic playout via Dalet Galaxy and Ross Xpression.
  • Operate robotic camera controls using Ross Cambot Software.
  • Operate SSL Audio platform.
  • Set-up and maintain studio equipment, set pieces, and lighting.
  • Work with Management and Engineering staff to continually refine workflows, creating new efficiencies and capabilities.
  • Document technical procedures and processes.
  • Participate in station-sponsored events and all assigned special projects.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Minimum of 3 years relevant experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, journalism, engineering, radio, television & film, operations, media production, related fields or equivalent experience.
  • 1 year experience working as a newscast Director and/or Technical Director
  • 1 year experience of hands-on work with Automated Production Control system

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience directing and operating television production systems for mid to major market news or live events.
  • Expertise with the Ross Overdrive Production Automation, including coding and preparation of rundowns, automation of video switchers, audio mixers, camera robotics, graphic systems and prompters.
  • Strong technical understanding and the ability to troubleshoot and work around operational issues.
  • Experience working under pressure in breaking news situations while being a calm leader in the control room.
  • Ability to work well and communicate effectively with others.
  • Self-motivated, highly creative, solution focused individual.
  • Find simple solutions to complex problems.
  • Punctual, regular, and dependable attendance.
  • Cover necessary job functions in an emergency capacity.
  • Bi-lingual (English & Spanish) a plus

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered
  • Must be willing to work on-site in West Hartford, CT
  • Must be able to and willing to work any shift, 24/7, willing to work long hours, on weekends and holidays in support of our station operations as needed.
  • Must be willing to work in severe weather/breaking news emergencies
  • Must be a member or be willing to become a member of the IBEW union
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be covered by Solutions, NBCU’s Alternative Dispute Resolution Program
  • Must be 18 years or older
  • Required On-Site: This position is required to be performed full-time from an NBCUniversal-designated worksite.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Emerging Products
description:

title: Full Stack Engineer (AI Native)
description:

VIZZIO Technologies Pte Ltd is a leading Singapore-based company specialising in mapping and modelling cities into high-fidelity 3D digital twins. Using an AI-automated pipeline, VIZZIO generates dimensionally accurate, geo-specific 3D models from satellite imagery, street video, and point clouds - with 89 cities mapped across 29.4 million km² of land area. title: Senior Analyst - Brand Insights
description:
What You’ll Do as a Senior Analyst - Brand Insights

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:

  • Lead the development and evolution of our brand understanding. You’ll be responsible for designing and evolving key measurement programmes including brand tracking, brand equity, audience understanding and brand positioning. You’ll manage the relationship with our agency partners, owning the budget and timeline of deliveries, and run quality checks to ensure all deliverables are up to standard. You'll create a clear and compelling view of how consumers perceive Primark across markets and against competitors.
  • Drive strategic insight programmes that uncover opportunities for brand growth and differentiation. Drawing on leading brand and behavioural science frameworks, you'll help shape the long-term vision for Brand Insights while exploring innovative approaches to representing the consumer voice across the business
  • Collaborate across central and local Brand & Marketing teams to establish opportunities to grow, including establishing measurement models, KPIs, and frameworks by supporting development of Primark’s brand strategy. Through building partnerships, you’ll influence key decisions through actionable insights that represent the consumers.
  • Deliver key outcomes in the first 12–18 months, including establishing brand KPIs and frameworks beyond the UK into priority global markets. You’ll develop foundational brand narratives for each market and provide strategic insights that inform decisions across Brand, Strategy, Finance and Customer & Digital teams
  • Drive activation of brand strategy through deep consumer understanding, feeding target audience insights, customer segmentation, qualitative/quantitative research, and external thought leadership. You’ll support local market implementation through championing market nuances, and the opportunities these provide.
  • Define insights frameworks for brand partnership and license, ensuring that ‘what impact will this have on the consumer’ is at the heart of all decisions. You’ll leverage social listening, primary research, brand personality understanding, and other exploratory methods to define a rationale behind Primark partnerships and license, including a clear position on who is the target customer.
  • Develop a holistic view of Primark’s brand health and competitive position, bringing together pre-existing insights, internal data, industry trends, market intelligence, thought leadership, industry networking, and by conducting primary research. Through this, you’ll represent how out target customer is exposed to brands generally, and how Primark fits into their experiences. You’ll continually monitor shifts in consumer attitudes, behaviours and expectations, ensuring the business has an up-to-date understanding of what drives brand salience, consideration and preference.

What You’ll Bring

We want every person in our organisation to feel like they’re making a key contribution. Here are some of the experiences and skills you’ll need for the role:

  • 5+ years in consumer insights/brand research/market research (ideally retail), strong use of GWI, brand tracking, social listening, qualitative research and synthesising insights; working with Strategy/Finance to translate insight into investment decisions; managing international insights; strong agency management across research, creative and media partners; trained or self‑taught in Marketing Science and theory.
  • Strong data structuring, trend interpretation and robustness checking; experienced in qualitative research management with agencies; able to create clear, business‑oriented narratives from complex data; curious about customers/competitors and implications for winning in market; enjoys building and interpreting systems (frameworks, dashboards).
  • Excellent storyteller who can present complex information clearly; confident working with Brand, Strategy, Finance, and senior commercial leaders; strong interpersonal and communication skills; high emotional intelligence; able to build persuasive narratives and trusted relationships across all levels of the organisation.
  • Collaborative team player across multiple functions and markets; effective partnership builder with international teams and vendors; proven ability to drive business objectives through cross‑functional collaboration; able to hold agencies accountable while fostering strong relationships.
  • Highly organised, detail‑oriented, able to prioritise projects and meet deadlines; strong planning and multi‑tasking skills; capable of both deep data interrogation and high‑level synthesis; operates with integrity, diplomacy, tact and professionalism; resilient, proactive and able to work independently.
  • Enthusiastic about insights and understanding consumers; driven by uncovering the story behind data; excellent attention to detail; strong narrative builder; trusted, emotionally intelligent, resilient and proactive; effective relationship‑builder with a high standard of professionalism.

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

title: Learning Transformation Senior Consultant - with German or French
description:
Learning Transformation Consultant

Level - Senior Principal
Practice – Workforce Transformation
Areas of expertise - Learning Managed Services or Upskilling & Reskilling Strategy or Learning Systems Integration (SI).

About your role

We are seeking experienced leaders to join our growing Learning Transformation Practice at Senior Principal level. You will play a pivotal role in shaping, selling, and delivering large-scale learning transformation programmes that help global organisations future-proof their workforce.

As a Senior Principal, you’ll combine strategic advisory, commercial acumen, and delivery excellence to lead complex, multi-tower engagements that transform how enterprises learn, reskill, and perform.

We are looking for consultants with experience in one or more of these three areas: Learning Managed Services, Upskilling & Reskilling Strategy & Learning Systems Integration (SI).

Key responsibilities include:

Sales & Growth Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end pursuit and sales cycles for large, complex learning transformation deals.
  • Shape solution blueprints, proposals, and client narratives that position Infosys as a trusted learning transformation partner.
  • Build relationships with Learning and Talent client stakeholders, and business leaders to identify opportunities for learning innovation and managed growth.
  • Collaborate across Infosys Consulting, Infosys Ltd, and BPM to integrate learning into broader technology, HR, and business transformation programmes.
  • Contribute to market visibility through thought leadership and GTM collateral and campaigns.

Programme Delivery & Leadership

  • Oversee design and delivery of complex learning programmes, ensuring high standards of quality, timeliness, and measurable impact.
  • Act as the executive sponsor and escalation point for delivery teams, ensuring client satisfaction and programme success.
  • Lead globally distributed teams, leveraging offshore delivery and vendor partnerships effectively.
  • Drive governance, risk management, and continuous improvement across delivery portfolios.
  • Manage, lead design and development capability when operating at scale production. Overseeing this talent and ensuring we are pushing boundaries and staying relevant and competitive with regards to design and development standards.

Strategy & Innovation

  • Bring a forward-looking perspective on learning and skills transformation—AI in learning, data-driven skills intelligence, and the shift toward Learning-as-a-Service.
  • Develop thought leadership and frameworks that strengthen Infosys’ market presence and value proposition.
  • Build and nurture partnerships across the learning technology ecosystem (LXPs, LMS, Skills Intelligence vendors etc.).

People and practice management:

  • Seeks to give team members stretching opportunities while providing support and ensuring quality and operational excellence
  • Lead collaborative sessions to help drive innovation and foster a culture of learning in the team
  • Define, implement and manage best practice development processes that enable the team to deliver high quality, scalable solutions. Proactively lead on improving existing processes / approaches where required
  • Encourages development of team members though formal and informal coaching
  • Gives authentic and constructive feedback
  • Reinforces our values, through day-to-day behaviour and change disrespectful behaviour
  • Acts as a team player, with an ability to integrate with new teams quickly

Requirements

We are looking for consultants with experience in one or more of these three areas: Learning Managed Services, Upskilling & Reskilling Strategy & Learning Systems Integration (SI).

  • 10–15+ years of experience in Learning, Talent, or Workforce Transformation, ideally within consulting or large-scale enterprise transformation environments.
  • Proven ability to sell and lead multi-million-dollar learning transformation programmes from strategy through to delivery.
  • Deep understanding of modern learning ecosystems, digital learning platforms, and global content supply chains.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional, and global teams within matrixed and multi-vendor environments.
  • Strong executive presence and influencing skills, able to engage credibly with C-suite stakeholders and shape strategic dialogue.
  • High commercial acumen with the ability to translate business strategy and transformation goals into measurable learning outcomes.
  • Strong personal impact, resilience, and gravitas, with the ability to influence and persuade clients and stakeholders to support major change and key decisions.
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented—able to tackle complex problems and deliver insightful, practical, and sustainable solutions.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a relentless drive for quality and excellence in all deliverables.
  • Skilled in facilitating collaboration and motivating teams to achieve high performance and shared success.
  • Effective in identifying and managing risks and issues during client engagements to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Confident operating both independently and collaboratively within fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong prioritisation and organisational skills, able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a professional services context
  • Have a broad business skill set including stakeholder management, problem-solving, and resilience
  • Have experience in gathering, validating, synthesizing, documenting, and communicating data and information for a range of audiences
  • Written and verbal communication skills in German or French
  • Have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and verbal communication skills in country’s official language(s) (C2 proficiency) and English (C2 proficiency).

Ideally, you’ll also have….

  • Proven experience in selling and delivering large-scale learning consultancy and transformation engagements, ideally within a consulting, advisory, or learning services organisation.
  • A strong understanding of client buying cycles, deal shaping, and solution development for learning transformation, managed services, or workforce upskilling programmes.
  • A primary degree and/or postgraduate qualification in a relevant field such as learning design, education, digital pedagogy, product design, or digital development.
  • Experience working within or alongside a digital learning products or services organisation, with exposure to emerging learning technologies and innovation.
  • A passion for shaping the future of learning through AI, data, and human-centred design approaches.

The Team

Our Workforce Transformation practice in Europe, with over 150 specialists, supports large global companies and most recognizable local brands in solving their most significant challenges around Human Capital Management (HCM) Transformation, Organizational Change and Agile ways of working.

Within the HCM Team, we offer various services enabling HR & HR Cloud Transformations through experience-driven HR Process Design, HR IT & Cloud Advisory, HR TOM & Service Delivery Design as well as overall HR Transformation Program Management.

About Infosys Consulting

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our .

Within Europe, we are recognized as one of the UK’s top firms by the Financial Times and Forbes due to our client innovations, our cultural diversity and dedicated training and career paths. Infosys is on the Germany’s top employers list for 2023. Management Consulting Magazine named us on their list of Best Firms to Work for. Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row.

We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal goals. Curious to learn more? We’d love to hear from you.... Apply today!

Benefits

Given that this is just a snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

title: EMDR Therapist

Therapists must have a niche(s) (children, couples, trauma, EMDR, family, etc.) with the availability to work evenings (4pm-8pm). We are specifically looking for an EMDR specialist for our Palm Beach Gardens office.

Caring Therapists provides a steady stream of referrals as well. The candidate must be independent, driven, collaborative, and enhance our fun, connected, and a positive-minded group of clinicians. The Successful Caring Therapists:

CARES ABOUT OTHERS

GOES THE EXTRA MILE

IN IT TO WIN IT

GOES ONWARD AND UPWARD

DOES THE RIGHT THING

Has the Following Skills:

  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Excellent communication and listening skills
  • Ability to build rapport quickly
  • Detail-oriented
  • Ability to communicate with compassion and empathy
  • Strong ability to manage time and prioritize tasks
  • Proficient in Office products, Excel and Google documents, use of Electronic Medical Records

About Us

Caring Therapists is the premier counseling center with locations throughout the state of Florida. We are a team of highly specialized therapists available days, evenings, and weekends.

title: Bli timvikarie inom vård & omsorg i Marks kommun!
description:
Är du en person som värdesätter utveckling, engagemang och omtänksamhet i ditt arbetsliv? Då skulle vi passa bra ihop – för det gör vi också. 

Genom att jobba hos oss är du med och bidrar till en bättre vardag för tusentals människor i Marks kommun. Inte minst din egen. Hos oss får du möjlighet att växa – både som person men också i din yrkesroll, samtidigt som det du jobbar med får ett helt samhälle att växa. Oavsett vad dina arbetsuppgifter är så kommer du göra livet för alla de som bor och verkar här lite enklare. Och det är något vi värdesätter högt. Vår vision är att vara en nära kommun med människan i fokus. Nära varandra, vår omvärld och framtiden. Vi vill vara ett närvarande samhälle som med lugn och värme står bakom ryggen och tar emot våra 35 000 invånare, 3 600 medarbetare och tusentals företagare. Då blir varenda medarbetare hos oss betydelsefull. Tillsammans ser vi till att ett helt samhälle fungerar. 



5 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Gör skillnad i höst och säkra ditt sommarjobb nästa år 2027 genom att bli vård- och omsorgsvikarie i Marks kommun!

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med människor och är intresserad av ett viktigt och omväxlande arbete. Ett arbete som innebär att du kommer att möta människor som är i behov av din hjälp, ditt stöd och ditt engagemang. 

Som vikarie blir du en värdefull och viktig del som hjälper till att få hela samhället att gå runt. Du blir betydelsefull för människor i olika åldrar och kommer att ge stöd till både män och kvinnor med den personliga omvårdnaden, i måltidssituationer samt främjar deras sociala kontakter. Du är en viktig resurs för andra människor, därför krävs det att du har ett genuint intresse för och tycker om att arbeta människor.


Bemanningsenheten i Marks kommun rekryterar och samordnar timvikarier inom vård och omsorg inom följande verksamheter:

	• Äldreomsorgen - Vård- och omsorgsboende & Hemtjänst


	• Funktionsstöd/LSS - Gruppboende, Serviceboende & Personlig assistans


	• Socialpsykiatri 
 

Våra verksamheter bedrivs dygnet runt, varje dag i veckan så du kommer att få arbeta dag, kväll och helg.
Vissa tjänster innefattar även nattarbete.

För att bli aktuell som timvikarie måste du finnas tillgänglig för arbete större delen av hösten. 
Detta då kontinuiteten är viktig för våra omsorgstagare, därför kommer vi att prioritera dig som kan arbeta större delen av hösten 2026.

Rekrytering av timvikarier sker löpande under hösten 2026. 


OBS!

Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte skicka in en ansökan här.
Kontakta i stället en av rekryterarna för att lämna in din ansökan på annat sätt.
Du hittar kontaktuppgifter i annonsen.
När du söker jobb i Marks kommun blir din ansökan en allmän handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen.
Det innebär att vem som helst kan begära ut inkomna ansökningar.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Du som söker skall ha:

	• Fyllt 18 år - Detta då vi följer Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3, § 9-12).


	• Ett stort engagemang, är serviceinriktad, trygg som person, empatisk och lojal.


	• En god förmåga att samarbeta och ett gott omdöme.


	• Förmåga att ta eget ansvar och utföra arbete självständigt.


	• God dator- och mobilvana.


	• God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i både tal och skrift.





Det är meriterande om:

	• Du har fullföljt eller har en pågående utbildning inom gymnasieskolans 3-åriga omvårdnadsprogram eller barn- och fritidsprogram.


	• Du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom vård och omsorg.


	• Du har tidigare erfarenhet av delegerade hälso- och sjukvårdsuppgifter så som läkemedelsdelegering.


	• Du har B-körkort samt cykelvana.


Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och intervjuer samt anställning kommer att ske löpande.

Det är viktigt att du lägger in rätt mejladress när du ansöker till oss.
Om du blir utvald till att komma på intervju får du besked om det via mejl.
Du kommer också att få förslag på intervjutider via mejl.

Om du blir kallad till intervju behöver du styrka din identitet på något av följande tre sätt: pass, nationellt ID-kort som visar medborgarskap eller ID-kort kombinerat med personbevis där medborgarskapet framgår. Är du medborgare i land utanför EU/EES behöver du även visa upp ett giltigt uppehållstillstånd och/eller arbetstillstånd i Sverige.

Innan vi kan erbjuda dig en eventuell anställning behöver vi även se ett utdrag från ditt belastningsregister.
Beställ gärna ditt belastningsregister i samband med att du skickar in din ansökan använd länk nedan för att beställa.
Det går även bra att beställa belastningsregistret till den digitala brevlådan som t.ex. Kivra.

https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/arbete-i-hemmet-med-aldre-och-personer-med-funktionsnedsattning-e-tjanst/

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.

Vi som jobbar inom Marks kommun utvecklar gemensamt vår tillsammanskultur genom att vi är engagerade, omtänksamma och utvecklande, till långsiktig nytta för individ och samhälle.

I våra tjänster lägger vi stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet. 

För vissa tjänster inom Marks kommun gäller särskilda krav utifrån lagstiftning och verksamhetens behov. Det kan innebära att säkerhetsprövning genomförs i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585), att svenskt medborgarskap krävs samt/eller att registerkontroll genomförs enligt gällande lagstiftning om registerkontroll.

Information om vad som gäller för den specifika tjänsten lämnas i samband med rekryteringsprocessen.

Som arbetsgivare främjar vi lika rättigheter, skyldigheter och möjligheter för alla medarbetare och värdesätter de kvaliteter som mångfald och en jämn könsfördelning kan tillföra verksamheten.

Marks kommun erbjuder olika personalförmåner såsom exempelvis attraktivt friskvårdsbidrag, rabatterat årskort på Västtrafik, pensions- och semesterväxling, samt möjlighet till distansarbete- och flexibel arbetstid utifrån verksamhetens behov och utformning. Det är också enkelt att pendla hit från exempelvis Göteborg, Borås och Varberg.

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt kontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Flight Scheduler - Global Security & Aviation - Onsite
description:
Help make high-priority travel safe, smooth, and on time. You will schedule corporate aircraft, flight crews, and added travel resources both domestic and some international. You will support senior leaders, Board members, and other approved guests. This role calls for sound judgment, close attention to detail, and a calm approach when plans change.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan aircraft, crew, and added resources for safe and timely travel.

  • Build schedules that meet business needs and Federal Aviation Administration rules. Balance aircraft use, crew readiness, flight time, and rest needs.

  • Work with pilots, the maintenance manager, and hangar staff. Confirm that aircraft and crews are ready and current.

  • Create clear trip plans. Send detailed itineraries and book ground travel and crew lodging.

  • Track flights and schedule changes. Share updates fast and help teams adjust while keeping service strong.

  • Keep the scheduling system accurate. Update crew data, trip logs, rest periods, crew status, airport details, and other key records.

  • Support the Corporate Angel Network by coordinating eligible flight schedules.

  • Complete post-flight records. Track data and prepare monthly reports that support planning and sound decisions.

  • Book travel for hangar staff related to flights, training and maintenance.

  • Flight following aircraft activities which require being on call during some evenings or weekends.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of experience in travel, aviation work, flight scheduling, dispatch, or a related field.

  • Knowledge of corporate aviation, including aircraft and crew limits, aircraft use, and airport or heliport options.

  • Ability to review new information, set priorities, and make sound choices in a fast-paced setting.

  • Strong service skills and executive presence. Clear written and verbal communication.

  • Demonstrated accuracy, reliability, discretion, and careful attention to detail.

  • Skill with Windows and Microsoft 365. Ability to learn and use aircraft scheduling systems.

  • Willingness to be on call as needed for critical evening or weekend travel requirements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with PFM or comparable aviation scheduling software.

  • Experience negotiating solutions and influencing partners across flight, maintenance, scheduling, and service teams.


If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

title: Prodajni savjetnik, Max City
description:
ŠTO ĆEŠ RADITI?
Kao prodajni savjetnik, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u stvaranju izvanrednog iskustva kupovine našim kupcima. Dočekivat ćeš kupce, usmjeravati ih kroz trgovinu, te pokazujući naše proizvode pomagat ćeš im u pronalasku onoga što traže. Prateći naše vrijednosti, pridonosit ćeš osobnom uspjehu, ali i uspjehu kompanije.

Također ćeš:

  • Dijeliti svoje znanje o modi i proizvodima, kako bi sa što više informacija pomogao/la kupcima pri donošenju odluke.
  • Surađivati sa svojim timom, kako biste pružili iznimnu uslugu kupcu na svakom koraku.
  • Brinuti da su prodajni prostor, kao i pozadinske prostorije, dobro opskrbljeni zalihama, organizirani i privlačni.
  • Pružati podršku prilikom otvaranja i zatvaranja trgovine.
  • Pozitivno predstavljati sebe i brend tijekom svake interakcije s kupcima.

S KIM ĆEŠ RADITI?

Naše trgovine su srce naše kompanije, u kojima se kupci direktno susreću s našim brendom. Kao dio dinamičnog tima u trgovini, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savjetnika, voditelja odjela, voditelja trgovine i vizualnih dekoratera, do glavnog blagajnika – doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog i gostoljubivog okruženja. Također, surađivat ćeš s timom sa šireg područja, kao i između trgovina, kako biste podijelili iskustva i zajedno postigli uspjeh. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imat ćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju usluga kupcima kako bi se osjećali samouvjereno te izrazili svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Izgradnjom značajnih veza s kupcima u našim trgovinama, modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

TKO SI?

  • Tražimo ljude s/sa...​
  • Iskustvom usluživanja kupaca na području mode, maloprodaji ili sličnim područjima, što će se smatrati prednošću.
  • Strašću za pomaganjem kupcima te interesom za modu ili maloprodaju –rado ćemo te naučiti svemu ostalom!

I ljude koji (su)...​

  • Uživaju u timskom i dinamičnom okruženju.
  • Komunikativni, kreativni i zainteresirani za rad s tehnologijom u trgovini.
  • Posjeduju snažnu želju za učenjem i daljnjim razvojem.
  • Fleksibilni i orijentiran na aktivnosti.

TKO SMO?

H&M Group je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i pothvata. Cilj nam je dokazati kako ne postoji kompromis između iznimnog dizajna, pristupačnih cijena i održivih rješenja. Želimo modu svima učiniti dostupnom, a naši kupci su u središtu svake naše odluke koju donosimo.

Čine nas tisuće strastvenih i talentiranih kolega, ujedinjenih zajedničkom kulturom te vrijednostima. Zajedno želimo iskoristiti svoju snagu, svoje postignuće i znanje kako bismo usmjerili modnu industriju prema inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ VOLJETI RADITI OVDJE?
U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična i gostoljubiva kompanija. Našim zaposlenicima nudimo atraktivne pogodnosti s opsežnim mogućnostima razvoja diljem svijeta.

  • 10% popusta za djelatnike na sve naše H&M Group robne marke, kako u trgovinama tako i online
  • H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovdje.​
  • Privatno zdravstveno dopunsko i dodatno osiguranje
  • Nagrada za dugogodišnji rad za 10, 15 & 20 godina
  • Naknada za topli obrok
  • Nagrada za umirovljenje
  • Dar za vjenčanje
  • Program preporuke

Naša jedinstvenost proizlazi iz kombinacije mnogih faktora– naše inkluzivne i suradničke kulture, naših snažnih vrijednosti i prilika za rast no ponajviše naših ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.​

Zajedno s nama napravi sljedeći korak u svojoj karijeri. Putovanje počinje ovdje.​

* Proces selekcije kandidata:

Radi efikasnog upravljanja s velikim brojem prijava za ulogu prodajnog savjetnika, koristimo online regrutacijsku metodu procjene koja se temelji na vještinama u nekim od naših trgovina. Morat ćeš ih ispuniti kao dio postupka prijave i provjere. Tvoji odgovori bit će ocjenjeni alatom za procjenu koji primjenjuje unaprijed definirane kriterije koje je postavila H&M Grupa.

Nakon dovršetka procjene imat ćeš priliku podijeliti povratne informacije i postaviti pitanja. Ako naiđeš na bilo kakve poteškoće ili preferiraš alternativnu metodu procjene, obrati se na recruitment_support@hm.com. Odabir alternativne metode neće utjecati na tvoju prijavu.

Više informacija o tome kako obrađujemo tvoje osobne podatke, pronađi u našoj Politici privatnosti.

** Predani smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, pravedan i temelji se na kompetencijama. Stoga te molimo da svojoj prijavi ne prilažeš motivacijsko pismo.​

title: Betongarbetare Halland
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Vill du arbeta i ett tryggt och etablerat bolag och bli en del av vårt team. A-Staffing Construction är ett bolag med lång erfarenhet och gott rykte. Vi sätter stort värde i att leverera kvalitet ut till våra beställare samtidigt som personalen ska må bra. I Syd – och Västsverige har vi arbetat på hundratals projekt alltifrån bottenplattor, bjälklag och väggar, broar, tunnlar, betongstommar, vattenkraftverk, infrastruktur, flerbostadshus och mycket mer. Vi är stolta över vår verksamhet och de projekt vi deltagit i. Med vår breda erfarenhet och våra trogna och stabila kunder så hittar vi projekt som passar just dig och din bakgrund. Våra beställare är byggföretag och vi arbetar inte mot privatpersoner. OBS: Arbetsplatsen är i Halmstad.

Erfarenhet

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet inom byggbranschen och trivs med ett praktiskt och varierande arbete. Du har god kunskap inom byggnation och gärna erfarenhet av betongarbeten, armering samt formsättning. Yrkesbevis som betongarbetare är meriterande, men vi värdesätter även dig som har skaffat dig motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Som person är du ansvarstagande, noggrann och van att arbeta självständigt. Du har ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt och bidrar till en god stämning på arbetsplatsen genom ett professionellt bemötande mot både kunder och kollegor. Hos A-Staffing Construction blir du en del av ett stabilt och växande företag med engagerade personalansvariga och kunniga kollegor. Vi erbjuder varierande projekt där du får möjlighet att utvecklas i din yrkesroll och arbeta tillsammans med ett team som värdesätter kvalitet, samarbete och yrkesstolthet.

Lön och anställningsvillkor

Du kommer att bli anställd på kollektivavtalet Byggavtalet vilket innebär: -Lön: Tidlön eller prestationslön beroende på projekt -Försäkringar -Arbetstidsförkortning -Friskvårdsbidrag Du blir inledningsvis anställd i sex månader. Om allting fungerar och vi trivs med varandra så övergår din anställning i tillsvidareanställning (fast anställning). Många av våra medarbetare har arbetat i över tio år tillsammans med oss.

Ansökan

Skicka in via länken, så ser vi fram emot kontakt.

Startdatum

Enligt överenskommelse, vi har arbetsplatser där vi är redo att ta emot någon direkt och vi har ytterligare arbetsplatser som startar längre fram.

Om oss

A-Staffing Construction är medlemmar i Byggföretagen och Almega Kompetensföretagen så du kan vara säker på att du alltid har rätt anställningsvillkor och kollektivavtal. I över 15 år har vi försett Sverige med duktiga yrkesarbetare på Byggavtalets område. Som anställd på A-Staffing kan du räkna med vårt engagemang för dig, dina arbetsuppgifter och din arbetsmiljö. Vår prioritet är öppenhet och tillgänglighet samt din trivsel, hälsa och säkerhet. Vi är även kvalitets- och miljöcertifierade enligt ISO 9001 och 14001.

title: Familjerättssekreterare, Solna stad
company: Socialförvaltningen, Barn- och ungdomsenheten, Gemensam familjerätt
description:
Vill du arbeta på en familjerätt där samarbete, utveckling och barnets bästa står i centrum? Då kan du vara en av våra nya kollegor.

Om arbetsplatsen

Vi tillhör organisatoriskt barn- och ungdomsenheten inom Solna stads socialförvaltning. Här finns en bred kompetens och vi arbetar för att utveckla ett nära samarbete mellan familjerätten, utredningsgrupper, mottagningsgrupp, placeringsgrupp, öppenvård, nätverksteam och fältverksamhet.

Hos oss värdesätter vi teamkänsla, kunskapsutbyte och ett öppet arbetsklimat. Vi tror att vi utvecklas bäst tillsammans och arbetar aktivt för att skapa en arbetsplats där det är naturligt att dela erfarenheter, stötta varandra i komplexa ärenden och bidra till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling.

Vi strävar efter att anpassa vårt uppdrag efter kommuninvånarnas behov och möter föräldrar och barn på ett sätt som är hjälpsamt och respektfullt. För oss är det viktigt att kombinera hög professionell kvalitet med ett gott bemötande och en hög tillgänglighet.

Vi har ett starkt fokus på barns delaktighet och på att utveckla arbetssätt som stärker barnets perspektiv. SofS är vårt grundläggande förhållningssätt både mellan oss och familjerna vi möter. Enheten vill samverka med våra andra enheter för att hålla BIFF-grupper och Hela barn.

Vårt erbjudande

Vi erbjuder:

  • ett stimulerande och ansvarsfullt arbete i en engagerad och kunnig arbetsgrupp
  • mentor och stöd från erfarna kollegor vid introduktion
  • extern handledning som vi är mycket nöjda med
  • löpande kompetensutveckling inom bland annat Signs of Safety, familjerättsliga utbildningar och Hela Barn
  • nyrenoverade fina lokaler i Solna Business Park med goda kommunikationer nära Sundbybergs station
  • Årsarbetstidoch friskvårdsbidrag, möjlighet till semesterväxling
  • Distansarbete i upp till 2 dagar per vecka i samråd med chef

Vad innebär arbetet?

Familjerätten arbetar både förebyggande och på uppdrag av andra myndigheter, framför allt tingsrätten. I det förebyggande arbetet erbjuder vi rådgivning, informationssamtal, frivilliga samarbetssamtal och upprättar avtal med målet att hjälpa föräldrar att hitta hållbara lösningar utifrån barnets bästa. Föräldrastödjande insatser genom Hela Barn och BiFF grupp ligger oss varmt om hjärtat. Vi arbetar för att stärka föräldrars samarbete och skapa förutsättningar för att barn ska få trygghet, stabilitet och goda relationer till sina föräldrar.

Barnets perspektiv är alltid i fokus. Vi träffar barn för att informera, lyssna och göra dem delaktiga i frågor som rör deras liv när föräldrar inte är överens. Vi har ett nära samarbete med Solna tingsrätt för att följa upp kvaliteten på vårt arbete och se till att tingsrätt får det underlag de behöver för att kunna fatta sina beslut. Våra underlag handlar om upplysningar, anordna umgängesstöd, hålla samarbetssamtal samt göra vårdnads-, boende- och umgängesutredningar. Utredningarna är vårt sätt att lyfta barnrättsperspektivet och känna att vi kan bidra till att göra skillnad.

Vårt mål är att hjälpa barn att få trygghet och stabilitet samt minska risker och öka säkerheten. Vi vill alltid utforska möjligheten att få barnens föräldrar att komma överens och hitta lösningar om det är lämpligt och möjligt.

Andra viktiga delar av uppdraget är adoptionsområdet samt faderskaps- och föräldraskapsutredningar. Genom dessa uppdrag bidrar vi till att barn får rätt till sitt ursprung, sin identitet och sina rättigheter. Hos oss i Solna, Sundbyberg och Ekerö arbetar vi alla med alla områden vilket gör arbetet både brett och utvecklande.

Kort sagt – hos oss får du ett varierande, kvalificerat och meningsfullt arbete där barnets bästa alltid står i centrum.

Vem söker vi?

Kvalifikationer:

  • socionomexamen
  • tidigare erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning samt familjerätt
  • erfarenhet av vårdnadsutredningar, rådgivning till separerade föräldrar, samarbetssamtal
  • du har goda kunskaper om lagstiftningen inom det familjerättsliga området
  • god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.

Tidigare erfarenhet av Signs of Safety ser vi som meriterande, likaså utbildning och/eller erfarenhet av att arbeta med Hela Barn.

Som person är du trygg, ansvarstagande och strukturerad. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat, är nyfiken på att utvecklas och delar gärna med dig av dina erfarenheter. Samtidigt har du förmåga att möta människor i svåra livssituationer med respekt, tydlighet och professionalism.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Mer information om ansökan

Vi söker två familjerättssekreterare. Tjänsterna är tillsvidareanställningar på heltid med tillträde snarast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Välkommen med din ansökan innehållandes endast CV senast fredagen den 11 september. I samband med din ansökan kommer du att få svara på några urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för det första urvalet i rekryteringsprocessen.

Om du inte har ett aktuellt utdrag ur belastningsregistret rekommenderar vi att du beställer ett sådant så snart som möjligt då vi behöver se detta innan du kan börja din anställning. Utdrag ur belastningsregistret får högst vara 1 år gammalt.

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Therése Gibbemark, therese.gibbemark@solna.se.

Solna stad har gjort medieval för samtliga rekryteringar, vi undanber oss därför samtal från annonssäljare eller säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter? Registrera inte din ansökan på webbplatsen/Varbi, utan ta kontakt med rekryterande chef för att veta hur du ska skicka in din ansökan. Du bör vara varsam med vilken information du delar i din ansökan. Delge därför bara information som är relevant för den aktuella tjänsten.

För facklig kontaktperson för tjänsten se www.solna.se/jobba-hos-oss/fackliga-kontaktpersoner

Öppen för alla Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

title: People Relations Specialist - 1 Year Project
description:
For this People Relations Specialist project, your focus will be to guide and enhance the relationship between the leaders and employees within the US Sales Market. Your role is crucial in fostering a positive work environment, resolving conflicts, and ensuring that employment policies and practices align with legal requirements. Understanding the broader business goals in your Sales Market and how people relations strategies align with and contribute to achieving those objectives. Equip HR Business Line and Business Leaders with the appropriate training, tools, and access to relevant information to be proactive in managing risk and People Relations related topics/cases.

This hybrid role reports into our People Relations Manager, US and is based out of an US Support Office location (Secaucus, New Jersey).

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

  • Focus on day-to-day people relations activities, supporting the HR Business Line in handling issues of conflict resolution, investigations, and policy interpretation
  • Handle escalated investigations and matters where a conflict exists for the HR Business Partner
  • Drive implementation plan of new and/or updated H&M Group social policies, guidelines or framework
  • Deliver on local people relations plans and prios aligned with global strategy and

priorities

  • Act on local legally needed adaptations of policies and standards
  • Provide strategic and operational advice to local management and HR Business Line
  • Keep up to date on employment law to ensure compliance
  • Govern and follow up on compliance for entire Sales Market
  • Ensure local grievance process that is in line with the Global grievance policy and handle grievance investigations
  • Ensure the respect for freedom of associations for all colleagues connected to our business
  • Create a trustful relationship with employee representatives
  • Secure that Managers are fully aware of their responsibilities and have a proactive internal dialogue
  • Drive risk assessments as a tool to identify hazards in the physical and psychosocial work environment
  • Participate in risk assessments to analyze and understand events which might lead to crisis and uncertainty in the organization e.g., internal controls or geopolitics context
  • Secure that crisis is handled in accordance with Our General People Principles - In times of crisis
  • Expectation to contribute to People Relations Network​
  • Occasional domestic and international travel may be required

Who You Are:

  • At least two years Employee/People Relations experience (may consider equivalent HR education + ER experience)
  • Some knowledge of federal, state, local US employment laws and regulations
  • Proven track record in developing, revising, and implementing HR policies and procedures to ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations
  • Demonstrated commitment to human rights advocacy within the workplace.
  • Proven experience in designing, implementing, and managing comprehensive occupational health and safety programs

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
  • You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match 401k, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
  • You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: salary range is $ 97,840-122,300 annually**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

title: Mulesoft Architect
description:
Mulesoft Architect at CapTech are part of a capable, highly motivated community who strive to continuously learn the latest tools and architectures to deliver innovative solutions for our clients. We design, develop, and deliver high-quality enterprise systems, as well as systems integrations and work in a project-based consulting environment.

CapTech Consultants enjoy a collaborative environment and have many opportunities to learn from and share knowledge with other developers, architects, and our clients. Our solutions include API-driven clients, microservice architectures, event-driven integrations, cloud deployments, serverless applications, and web and portal front ends.

Specific responsibilities for the Mulesoft Architect position include:

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to deliver a technical solution that meet the unique needs of our clients.
  • Partner with clients on cross‑functional, team‑based projects to deliver scalable Mulesoft solutions across the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) using Agile methodologies
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor, managing architectural scope while aligning technical solutions with business goals
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, setting clear expectations and guiding decision‑making
  • Create quality deliverables to communicate technical solutions to appropriate audiences.
  • Leverage CapTech’s internal programs and self-directed training to continually develop industry relevant knowledge and skills.
  • Communicate effectively to team members with varying degrees of technical knowledge.
  • Demonstrate technical thought leadership by contributing to architectural standards, best practices, and reusable accelerators
  • Mentor architects and developers through architecture reviews, communities of practice, and ongoing knowledge sharing
  • Participate in technical pre‑sales activities, including solution design, estimations, and delivery scoping for prospective clients
  • Gain exposure to a variety of clients, business models, and industry verticals

Specific qualifications for the Mulesoft Architect position include:

  • Experience with MuleSoft 4.x at a high architectural level
  • Project experience with MuleSoft Integrations
  • 10+ years software development experience
  • Extensive knowledge of Integration patterns
  • Experience creating Mule applications in Anypoint Studio
  • Ability to design APIs and publish to Anypoint Exchange
  • Familiarity with designing APIs in RAML
  • Applied knowledge of API Development using REST and/or SOAP
  • Experience integrating Enterprise applications such as Salesforce, SAP, Workday, Oracle ERP
  • Familiarity with microservice architectures, design patterns, and monitoring tools
  • Experience with cloud providers such as Azure, AWS, and/or GCP a plus
  • Experience with relational database technologies, both traditional and current (NoSQL)
  • Experience with the CI/CD pipeline
  • Experience working with LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, Mistral, etc.) in production settingExperience with prompt engineering, MCP and RAG, and agentic AI architectures
  • Strong understanding of conversational UX and prompt evaluation metrics
  • Experience with agentic frameworks in practice (langchain, n8n, pydantic, etc)
  • Experience with vibe coding and multi-agents
  • Demonstrated experience in enterprise security practices

We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lasting and rewarding career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. You decide where and how you want to develop, and we help get you there with customizable career progression and a comprehensive benefits package to support you along the way. Alongside our suite of traditional benefits encompassing generous PTO, health coverage, disability insurance, paid family leave and more, we’ve launched extended benefits to help meet our employees’ needs.

  • Learning & Development – Programs offering certification and tuition support, digital on-demand learning courses, mentorship, and skill development paths

  • Modern Health –A mental health and well-being platform that provides 1:1 care, group support sessions, and self-serve resources to support employees and their families through life’s ups and downs
  • Carrot Fertility –Inclusive fertility and family-forming coverage for all paths to parenthood – including adoption, surrogacy, fertility treatments, pregnancy, and more – and opportunities for employer-sponsored funds to help pay for care

title: Merchandising Part Time Days
description:
Your Impact at Lowe's

As a Lowe's Merchandising Services Associate, you are a key connection point between Merchandising and Store Operations, allowing us to deliver a great shopping experience in every Lowe's store. If you want to build eye-catching displays and implement strategies that showcase in-demand products, you'll enjoy working with our Merchandising Services Team.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Keep your weekends free with a set weekday schedule. *
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.
For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

*Live Nursery MST Associates may be required to work weekend shifts.

Your Day at Lowe's

As a Merchandising Services Associate, you ensure our store's signage, pricing information, and displays are accurate so merchandise is easy to locate. You create product displays that are safe, clean, visually appealing, and easy for customers to access.

While most of your time will be spent on activities that don't involve customer interaction, you may be expected to engage with customers when the opportunity arises. You'll be expected to listen to customers and answer questions, communicate product or warranty information, and assist in locating or handling merchandise.

Key Responsibilities
  • Complete merchandising resets and service-related projects according to Lowe's specifications and provide proof of completion for assigned tasks
  • Verify buyback items and ensure they are pulled, prepped, and ready for shipping
  • Update/validate wayfinding and product location signage, as well as digital maintenance of this information throughout the store
  • Confirm product pricing information is clearly visible and replace any missing price labels
  • Help drive add-on sales by staging clearance products, sorting products in proper locations, and ensuring displays are placed appropriately throughout the store
  • Repair/replace damaged or missing items, including signage, merchandise and displays.
  • Communicate project priorities, schedule, and needs with Merchandising Services Team and Manager
  • Analyze metrics and provide feedback on project execution and in-store service to store, market, and corporate leaders
  • Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications
  • Read, write, and perform basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction)
  • Ability to hear, listen, and to communicate verbally with others
  • Utilize web-based computer programs to accomplish assigned tasks
  • Ability to sit and stand for long periods of time
  • Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without accommodation

Preferred Qualifications
  • Lowe's sales floor experience
  • Experience performing product merchandising tasks, including reading planograms and setting up and tearing down displays.
  • Experience operating power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • Working knowledge of essential tools (e.g., hand tools, drills, saws, etc.)

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

title: Broista – Clearfield, UT
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

But let’s be real, this job isn’t for everyone. It’s fast, high-energy, and physically demanding. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and keeping up with a steady flow of customers all while delivering next-level service. As the face of Dutch Bros, you’ll connect with customers, hustle with heart, and bring positive energy onto every single shift.

Who You Are:

  • A people person who thrives on connection and loves making someone’s day.
  • Adaptable and quick; you can handle a rush and keep the kindness rolling.
  • Team-oriented and ready to support your crew, no matter what’s needed.
  • Positive and considerate; even when it gets busy or during inclement weather you continue to show up.
  • Committed to growth and always looking for ways to improve.

What You’ll Do:

  • Engage. Greet every customer with a smile, make genuine connections, and ensure every visit is full of kindness & fun.
  • Educate. Help customers navigate the menu and discover new favorites, all while delivering top-tier service.
  • Embody. Live out the Dutch Bros values: radiate kindness, get up early, stay up late, and change the world.
  • Stay Fast & Focused. Work efficiently to craft high-quality drinks while keeping up with the hustle of a busy shop.
  • Be Reliable. Show up on time, communicate your availability, and be ready to roll when your shift starts.
  • Keep it Clean. Maintain a tidy workspace and follow food safety standards.

What to Expect:

  • Fast-paced, high-energy environment. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and handling a steady flow of customers for up to 10-hour shifts!
  • Crew-first mentality. We support each other, have everyone’s backs, and get the job done together.
  • Weather-ready. Be prepared for all conditions; rain or shine. Don’t worry we’ve got Dutch gear to help!
  • Some heavy lifting. You may need to push, pull, lift, or carry up to 65 lbs (talk about a workout).
  • Reliable transportation. You’ll need to show up on time for scheduled shifts and mandatory meetings.
  • Training & Development. We’ll set you up for success with training, certifications, and knowledge tests to ensure you meet the Dutch Bros standards.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • We’ve got your back. Competitive pay & tips, opportunities for tuition reimbursement, and career growth within the shops, HQ, Emerging Talent Program, and warehouse/fulfillment opportunities.
  • Perks on perks. Free drinks & food on shift, exclusive Dutch Bros swag and giveaway items, and a work environment like no other.
  • Make a difference. Every cup you serve supports local & national communities and brings people together.
  • Room to grow. We believe in pouring into our people; Broista today, leader tomorrow! We’re set to double in size within the next three years which means a ton of growth opportunities for you.

At Dutch Bros, our culture is unmatched. We’re a fun, tight-knit crew that supports each other and creates connections you won’t find anywhere else. Ready to make a massive difference together?!

Compensation:

Up to $18.50 per hour

Number includes an average tip of $8.50 per hour. What we strive for: a fun environment, great co-workers, and a chance to make a difference in your community. What we don't guarantee: tip averages. Actual tips may vary based on a variety of factors including location, position, hours, and quality of service. Average hourly tips are based on 2025 reporting.

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Content Strategist & Writer
description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a growth-minded content strategist and exceptional writer who combines content strategy, experimentation, and product thinking with hands-on content creation.

You’ll help thousands of people who visit the NOCD website or download the NOCD app learn about OCD, feel less alone, and ultimately start specialized treatment sooner. You’ll write, design, and optimize content-driven user flows, educational articles, and marketing materials, improve key funnel flows, and experiment with AI-first approaches to personalization.

We’re looking for someone who is both creative and quantitative—a strong writer and storyteller who is equally excited about testing hypotheses, analyzing results, and using those insights to make content more effective.


This is a part-time contract but would be open to a full-time employee for the right candidate


What You'll Do

  • Design and test content-driven product experiences across onboarding, booking, education, and other key Member journeys to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Identify and address friction in critical app flows using content, experimentation, Member insights, and product thinking.
  • Write and optimize high-quality content across formats, including in-app messaging, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, educational content, product copy, and growth campaigns.
  • Translate complex healthcare and OCD-related topics into clear, empathetic, and motivating content that helps Members understand their experiences and take action.
  • Build and test AI-first content workflows that enable more personalized, adaptive, and scalable Member experiences.
  • Use qualitative insights and performance data to develop and test messaging, understand what resonates, and continually improve content effectiveness.
  • Partner across Lifecycle, Web, Product, Engineering, Design, Intake Ops, and subject-matter experts to launch experiences and apply learnings across the Member journey.
  • Maintain a high bar for brand voice, editorial quality, and clinical accuracy while managing multiple projects and experiments in a fast-paced environment.

Ideal Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of experience in content strategy, growth marketing, product marketing, content-driven growth, copywriting, or a related role.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to create clear, engaging, action-oriented content across formats.
  • Strong content strategy and messaging instincts, including experience developing and testing content that drives measurable action.
  • Experience with—or strong interest in—product growth, funnel analysis, conversion rate optimization, and experimentation.
  • Comfortable using quantitative data and qualitative insights to develop hypotheses and guide decisions.
  • Ability to translate complex scientific, technical, or healthcare information into accessible and compelling content.
  • Comfortable collaborating across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and subject-matter experts.
  • Excited to leverage AI for content development, experimentation, and personalization.
  • Highly agile and comfortable moving between strategy, hands-on writing, experimentation, and execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passionate about mental health and NOCD’s mission, with an appreciation for the lived experiences of people impacted by OCD.
  • Based in the Chicago, IL area and able to work 2 days/week in NOCD’s downtown office.


Why Join NOCD?

  • Join a mission-driven company transforming access to evidence-based behavioral healthcare.
  • Take ownership of a critical growth lever: helping more people understand OCD, engage with NOCD, and start effective treatment.
  • Shape how content works across both product and marketing, using app insights to improve conversion and fuel broader growth.
  • Experiment with AI, personalization, content, and product growth at a meaningful scale.

title: Project Manager (Data Centre)
description:
About the Opportunity

Our client is a fast-growing technology infrastructure company developing and operating high-density data centre capacity across Southeast Asia, supporting the rapidly growing demand for AI, GPU computing, high-performance computing and large-scale cloud workloads.


The company is vertically integrated, owning and operating the infrastructure required to support customers' critical compute requirements.


As the Project Manager, you will take ownership of data centre delivery from an empty shell through commissioning and final handover. This is a highly hands-on role with significant decision-making authority, working across design, procurement, construction, commissioning and customer delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the project end-to-end, including project brief, budget, programme, risks, design, commissioning and handover.
  • Translate contractual technical requirements into clear delivery specifications and manage design consultants against these requirements.
  • Lead procurement activities including BOM development, tendering, vendor selection, purchase orders and long-lead equipment.

  • Lead and manage commissioning through Levels 1–5, including customer-witnessed testing.
  • Ensure formal acceptance and delivery by the committed Ready for Service (RFS) date.
  • Coordinate complete project documentation and handover to Operations and the customer.
  • Remain the key customer delivery contact following service commencement.
  • Manage customer expansions, variations and change orders.
  • Hold contractors, consultants and vendors accountable for project commitments and timelines.


Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Building Services Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 6–10 years of experience in data centre or mission-critical project delivery.
  • Proven experience delivering at least two data centre fit-outs end-to-end, from empty shell through operational handover.
  • Hands-on experience managing integrated systems testing and commissioning.
  • Strong understanding of critical power and cooling systems, with the ability to read and challenge single-line diagrams and construction specifications.
  • Proven ownership of a project budget of USD 5 million or more and accountability for project delivery timelines.
  • Experience delivering projects against an external customer's contracted technical specifications.
  • Ability to independently manage projects and hold contractors and vendors accountable.
  • Experience with colocation, wholesale or build-to-suit data centre providers.

This is a strong fit if you want to work hands-on with cutting-edge deep learning in a domain where the technical challenge is high and the impact is tangible.

Job Description
  • You will develop and optimize deep learning models for end-to-end driving.
  • You will design and work with spatio-temporal neural networks.
  • You will build scalable pipelines for data processing and model training.
  • You will train models on large-scale datasets and integrate them into production systems.
  • You will explore and evaluate architectures such as transformers and recurrent neural networks.
  • You will collaborate with specialist teams to deploy models for real-world use.
Requirements
  • Deep knowledge of spatio-temporal neural networks.
  • Strong background in deep learning, software development, and data engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Strong proficiency in C++.
  • Solid understanding of statistics and geometry.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, together with effective collaboration skills.
  • Ability to complete a mandatory background check before start.
Nice to have
  • Experience with transformers.
  • Experience with RNNs.
  • Experience with multi-head attention.
  • Experience with perception systems, including computer vision, lidar, and radar.
  • Experience with tracking.
  • Experience with sensor fusion.
What We Offer
  • Permanent employment at Avaron AB
  • Occupational pension
  • Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year
Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.
