Du arbetar i team och har varierande arbetsuppgifter: du serverar gäster, håller rent och snyggt i restaurangen, jobbar i köket med att laga burgare och pommes, och ansvarar för kassan där du ser till att gästerna får det som beställts varor. Hos oss är arbetsglädje, gemenskap och utveckling alltid i centrum. Så under dina första dagar lär du dig jobbet steg för steg av din restaurangchef eller en erfaren kollega och på vår lärplattform MAX Academy via digitala utbildningar.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

  • Servera gäster, ge ett schyst bemötande och skapa serviceupplevelser i världsklass
  • Hålla rent och snyggt i restaurangen
  • Laga burgare, smoothies och pommes i köket
  • Ansvara för kassan och se till att gästerna får det som beställts
  • Arbeta i team och stötta dina kollegor

Vad erbjuder vi?

  • Ett fartfyllt jobb i ett sammansvetsat team med mycket goda möjligheter att växa och utvecklas
  • Interna utbildningar och tydliga karriärvägar
  • Lön och villkor enligt kollektivavtal samt friskvårdsbidrag
  • En arbetsplats där bemötandet, goda burgare, en ren och fräsch restaurang och snabb service alltid står i fokus
  • En kultur där vi lägger stor vikt vid hälsa, miljö och socialt ansvar

Hur går processen till?

För våra tjänster som restaurangmedarbetare har vi valt ett enklare och mer relevant sätt att söka jobb. Det betyder att du inte behöver skicka in CV eller personligt brev. I stället får du svara på några urvalsfrågor och genomföra ett Servicetest. Vi rekommenderar att du svarar så utförligt och ärligt du kan på frågorna.

När du har skickat in din ansökan får du ett mejl med en länk till Servicetestet. Testet består av olika situationer som kan uppstå i vardagen på MAX, där du får beskriva hur du skulle agera. På så sätt får du redan tidigt en bra bild av hur det är att jobba hos oss. Testet tar cirka 15 minuter att genomföra.

När vi har gått igenom både din ansökan och ditt test återkopplar vi till dig så snart vi kan. Går du vidare i processen blir du inbjuden till intervju. Om du inte går vidare får du besked via mejl. Vi hanterar ansökningarna löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Observera att Servicetestet är ett obligatoriskt steg i vår rekryteringsprocess och att vi därför inte kan ta kandidater vidare som inte genomför testet.

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

Vill du läsa om hur vi hanterar dina personuppgifter? Gå in på www.max.se/dataskydd

title: Head of Pricing & Margin
description:
Purpose Of Role:

The Head of Pricing & Margin will lead Connected Kerb's pricing, energy portfolio and power procurement strategy across the operational charging network.

Acting as the Company's subject matter expert on electricity markets, energy procurement, flexibility services and energy risk management, the role will be responsible for maximising profitability through effective tariff design, forecasting, portfolio optimisation, hedging strategies and ancillary revenue opportunities.

Working across Finance, Commercial, Marketing, Operations and Technology, the role will provide strategic expertise on pricing, procurement, market developments, energy risk and margin performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Pricing Strategy & Margin Ownership

  • Lead the development and execution of pricing, margin and tariff strategies to deliver the Company's financial objectives.
  • Partnering with Marketing and Finance to develop tariff strategies across the charging network, considering customer demand, utilisation, competitor pricing and power market conditions.
  • Lead scenario planning, pricing strategy evaluation and sensitivity modelling to support commercial and investment decisions, drawing upon analysis and insights from Marketing, Finance and external market advisors.
  • Establish pricing governance, including review cycles, approval processes and performance monitoring.
  • Own margin reporting, forecasting and performance analysis, providing insights and recommendations to support executive and Board decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to utilise customer, utilisation and competitor insights in the development of tariff and pricing strategies, whilst retaining ownership of pricing recommendations and margin outcomes.

Margin Growth & Optimisation

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to improve profitability through pricing optimisation, smart charging, operational efficiencies and commercial innovation.
  • Identify and deliver opportunities to improve margin performance beyond budget assumptions.
  • Evaluate and implement opportunities within flexibility markets, balancing services, reserve mechanisms, RTFO schemes, carbon credits and other ancillary revenue streams.
  • Monitor and optimise the commercial performance of existing customer agreements, including pricing mechanisms, rebates and profit-sharing arrangements.
  • Support customer negotiations and contract reviews by providing pricing, tariff and margin expertise.

Power Procurement, Portfolio Management & Energy Risk

  • Lead the development and execution of the Company's energy procurement, portfolio management and supply strategy.
  • Own the energy portfolio P&L, including procurement costs, flexibility revenues and energy margin performance.
  • Develop forecasting models covering electricity demand, charging utilisation, renewable generation and flexibility opportunities.
  • Implement hedging strategies to manage wholesale market volatility and optimise commercial returns.
  • Monitor and manage energy market exposures, balancing arrangements and associated financial risks.
  • Establish reporting and governance processes for portfolio performance, market risk, forecast accuracy and margin delivery.
  • Build and maintain relationships with suppliers, aggregators, traders, flexibility providers and other market participants.
  • Monitor regulatory and market developments, providing insight on commercial risks, opportunities and strategic implications.
  • Partner with Finance on cashflow forecasting, treasury impacts and energy cost reconciliation activities.

Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the Company’s advisor on electricity markets, procurement, pricing and margin performance.
  • Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Operations, Technology and Finance teams to improve profitability and customer outcomes.
  • Support Board, investor and lender discussions relating to energy strategy, procurement and commercial performance.
  • Lead and manage relationship with specialist external resources, consultants and advisors.
  • Coordinate decision-making where pricing, utilisation, customer outcomes, risk management and business performance intersect.

Requirements

Qualifications, Skills and Experience

  • Min 5 years management experience within electricity supply, trading, aggregation, flexibility services or the wider energy sector.
  • Strong understanding of UK electricity markets, power procurement, energy supply structures and wholesale market dynamics.
  • Strong knowledge of flexibility markets, ancillary services, balancing mechanisms and regulatory frameworks.
  • Demonstrable experience designing and implementing energy procurement, trading or hedging strategies.
  • Significant experience managing energy portfolio risk, forecasting demand and analysing market exposures.
  • Proven commercial and financial acumen, including P&L ownership, margin management and business performance reporting.
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative modelling capability, including forecasting, scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis.
  • Experience leading and developing teams and managing external consultants, advisors and suppliers.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence Boards, Executive Teams and senior external partners.
  • Experience operating within a high-growth, scaling or private-equity-backed environment desirable.
  • Exposure to EV charging, infrastructure, mobility, utilities or regulated sectors would be advantageous.

Benefits

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Competitive Pension Scheme - via Royal London
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working model
  • 28 days of holidays and generous Family Leave policies
  • Central London location - Waterloo
  • Lots of opportunities to socialise!

Why should you choose Connected Kerb as your next career move?

  • We are passionate about people and will work with you to define opportunities to develop your career
  • Lots of opportunities to really develop your expertise.
  • A flat organisation, where exceptional talents can make a real impact.
  • A diverse and exciting work atmosphere, working with passionate and talented teams.

Connected Kerb is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees. We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join Connected Kerb.

Please note, we do not accept speculative CVs and we are not accepting CVs submitted by recruitment agencies.

title: Construction Technician (SWPPP)
description:
If you are looking for a dynamic, fast-growth company with big ideas, you have come to the right place! GTA is looking for a Construction Technicianin the Roanoke, VA area. Responsibilities include visiting construction sites to perform Stormwater Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP) inspections to ensure erosion and sediment control elements are installed and functioning properly. A summary report, including photographs of deficient areas and systems, is required at the end of each inspection on the same date that the inspection was performed. Candidates may perform SWPPP (Storm water Pollution Protection Plan) inspections at various sites through Virginia. This is an EXCELLENT opportunity for a new graduate with interests in geology, geotechnical engineering, and construction project management looking to start their career with a stable, growing company. Ample opportunities for training, certifications and career advancement. You must own a reliable vehicle, have a good driving record, like working with people, and enjoy working outdoors. Experience is preferred, but we will accept entry level candidates and provide training!

Requirements

Successful candidates MUST have:

  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • SWPPP certification provided through EPA or DEQ is a plus, but not required.
  • Own a reliable vehicle, have a valid driver’s license, and have a good driving record
  • Enjoy working outdoors
  • Ability to work alone as well as in a group setting

This position may require standing for extended durations as well as repetitive motions such as lifting or hammering and walking along difficult terrain. The employee must have the ability to use their hands to handle, finger or feel; reach, climb or balance; crouch, stoop, crawl, kneel and sit, see and smell; including close, distance and peripheral vision, depth vision and ability to focus. The employee will regularly lift and/or move 60 pounds; and occasionally move 80 pounds or more (such as a loaded wheelbarrow of concrete or soil samples).

title: Motviktstruckförare till lager i Falkenberg
description:
Om företaget

Vi söker nu erfarna truckförare till vår lagerkund i Falkenberg.

Vad erbjuder rollen?

Som truckförare hos vår kund ansvarar du för att på ett säkert och effektivt sätt hantera och förflytta gods inom verksamheten. Arbetet innebär bland annat lastning och lossning, intern transport av material samt placering och hämtning av varor på lager och andra angivna platser. Du arbetar noggrant och strukturerat för att säkerställa att rätt gods hamnar på rätt plats och att det dagliga flödet fungerar så smidigt som möjligt.

Rollen är varierande och passar dig som trivs med ett praktiskt arbete, högt tempo och att ta eget ansvar. Tjänsten innebär skiftarbete, vilket ställer krav på flexibilitet och möjlighet att arbeta varierande arbetstider.

Vem är du?

För att vara aktuell för tjänsten behöver du ha truckkort för motviktstruck och erfarenhet av truckkörning. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och säkerhetsmedveten i ditt arbete. Du trivs med ett fysiskt och praktiskt arbete där tempot kan variera, och du har lätt för att samarbeta med kollegor samtidigt som du kan ta eget ansvar. Eftersom tjänsten innebär skiftarbete behöver du vara flexibel och ha möjlighet att arbeta varierande arbetstider.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan

Låter tjänsten intressant?

Välkommen med din ansökan via effektiv.se. Intervjuer kommer att ske löpande. Vill du veta mer om tjänsten kontakta gärna Ebba på ebba.bremberg@effektiv.se

Effektiv rekryterar evidensbaserat med arbetspsykologiska tester och strukturerade intervjuer. Därför behöver du inte skicka något personligt brev, vi fokuserar på din kompetens, potential och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

Om Team Effektiv

Sedan 2013 har Effektiv hjälpt kandidater och företag att hitta rätt matchning.

Vi har en sportslig attityd och erbjuder schyssta villkor, kollektivavtal och goda förutsättningar för dig som blir en del av Team Effektiv. Det har gjort oss till en attraktiv arbetsgivare, vilket utmärkelserna Årets Bemanningsaktör och Årets Karriärföretag är ett bevis på.

Med rötterna i idrottens laganda genomsyras Effektivs arbete av värdeorden Glada, Utforskande, Långsiktiga och Driftiga (GULD), med målet att ta guld tillsammans med kandidater, konsulter och kunder. Varje dag.

title: Data Analyst - Revenue Management
description:
Position Summary

The Data Analyst will be a key member of the Revenue Management team, responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that support strategic pricing decisions. The Analyst will use their analytical skills to gather, validate, and implement pricing strategies based on performance data. In addition will provide managerial reporting and trends for revenue performance. The position works closely with our team of internal analysts, external business partners, and our information technology group. The primary goal is to help us improve the revenue generating effectiveness of our consumer by translating complex and massive data sets into actionable insights and recommendations for senior management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of large datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and variances
  • Apply data mining techniques to extract meaningful insights
  • Build and maintain data models that reflect complex business processes and relationships
  • Create clear, comprehensive reports and presentations for stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver customized insights
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and security by following governance standards and best practices
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation abilities.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure, accurately meet deadlines, present a professional demeanor and work well independently is essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role or graduate in above fields from top universities.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Highly proficient in Excel and comfortable with using formulas, vlookups and pivot table and graph
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is helpful but not required
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively

Preferred Skills:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field

Compensation

Base Pay Range: $95,000 - $110,000

Workplace

  • One of our values pillars is to work as One Team and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

**Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.**

title: Platschef
description:
Om tjänsten

Som platschef har du det övergripande ansvaret för produktion, ekonomi och medarbetare inom dina projekt. Du leder projekten från start till mål och skapar förutsättningar för ett framgångsrikt samarbete mellan kunder, medarbetare och underentreprenörer. I rollen arbetar du aktivt med att utveckla ditt team samtidigt som du säkerställer att lagar, regler och interna riktlinjer efterlevs. För att lyckas i rollen har du stöd av bland annat KMA, entreprenadingenjör och inköp, samtidigt som du har ett nära samarbete med kollegor.

Du ansvarar för att projekten genomförs enligt uppsatta mål och överenskomna ramar avseende tid, ekonomi, kvalitet, miljö och arbetsmiljö. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med kunder och beställare där långsiktiga relationer och affärsmässighet är viktiga framgångsfaktorer.

Vi arbetar med projekt, ramavtal och serviceuppdrag. Många av våra uppdrag utförs i fastigheter med kvarboende eller i verksamheter som pågår samtidigt som arbetet utförs. Det ställer höga krav på planering, flexibilitet, kommunikation och kundfokus.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

  • Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetare och projektteam
  • Planera, styra och följa upp projekt genom hela byggprocessen
  • Ansvara för anbud, kalkyler, prognoser, kontrakt och inköp
  • Säkerställa projektens ekonomi och resultat
  • Skapa, utveckla och vårda långsiktiga kundrelationer
  • Identifiera och utveckla nya affärsmöjligheter
  • Säkerställa att projekten genomförs enligt gällande krav inom kvalitet, miljö och arbetsmiljö

Vi söker dig som

  • Har byggteknisk utbildning eller motsvarande dokumenterad arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig
  • Har erfarenhet från byggbranschen, gärna i en ledande roll
  • Har god kunskap om produktionsplanering, projektledning och projektekonomi
  • Är en trygg och engagerande ledare som skapar förtroende och delaktighet
  • Har ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt och trivs med kundkontakter
  • Är strukturerad, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad
  • Har god kommunikativ förmåga och uttrycker dig väl på svenska i tal och skrift
  • Innehar B-körkort

Urval sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta:

Yves Bagona, bitr arbetschef 072- 33 30 28

Ewa Näsström, HR-partner, 072-533 52 02

Ansökan och övrig information

Klicka på "Sök tjänsten" nedan för att komma till vårt rekryteringssystem och söka jobbet som platschef hos oss. Urval sker löpande så tillsättning kan ske innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vänligen observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post. Sista ansökningsdag 20 september.

Vi kan komma att genomföra bakgrundskontroller på våra slutkandidater som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess.

I denna rekrytering har vi gjort ett aktivt val av annonsering och rekryteringsstöd och avböjer oss vänligt men bestämt kontakt från rekryterings- eller annonseringsbolag.

Vi erbjuder

I Peabkoncernen blir du delaktig i det spännande arbetet att bygga framtidens hållbara samhälle. Vi engagerar oss i sociala frågor och i frågor som rör miljön för de människor som nu och i framtiden påverkas av det vi bygger och anlägger. Vi vill tillvarata all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden och eftersträvar mångfald.

Det är viktigt för oss att du delar våra kärnvärden jordnära, utvecklande, personliga och pålitliga eftersom de är grundläggande för det vi gör. Hos oss finns stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling. Vill du bygga ett hållbart samhälle med oss?

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Peab är Nordens samhällsbyggare med 13 000 medarbetare och en omsättning på 60 miljarder kronor. Med lokal närvaro och fokus på egna resurser utvecklar, anlägger och bygger vi vardagen där livet levs. Huvudkontoret finns i Förslöv på Bjärehalvön i Skåne. Aktien är noterad vid Nasdaq Stockholm.

Vi har fått flera intressanta projekt och söker nu Platschef till våra byggserviceprojekt hos oss i Umeå. Vill du vara med att bygga något som består, påverkar och berör samhället kring oss? Vill du få möjlighet att utvecklas själv som ledare och medarbetare?

Då ska du ta chansen att söka till oss på Peab!

title: 3M Program Manager
description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented 3M Program Manager to join our team in Honolulu, HI This is an onsite position.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Coordinate with Ship’s Maintenance and Material Management (3M) staff in execution of Commander Naval Surface Pacific’s (COMNAVSURFPAC) 3M program for all Naval Surface Force assets worldwide.

  • Provide maintenance and logistics database support for various interfaces to include: PMSMIS, MDS, SCLSIS, CDMD-OA and RADWEB.

  • Provide oversight to the Integrated Class Maintenance Plans (ICMPs), repair standards and guidance documents, and Quality Assurance (QA) program, as they relate to shipboard and shore preventive maintenance.

  • Review all COMNAVSURFPAC bulk loads to ensure that all work candidates/notifications from INSURV, SURFMEPP, C5RA, and various outside inspection teams are valid and correct prior to loading into command databases for brokering and execution.

  • Provide coordination to all CNSP 3M Coordinators onboard DDG, CG, LHA/LHD, LPD, LCC, LCS, MCM, PC, LAWS, FFG-62, ESD/B, un-manned units, and shore-based units.

  • Provide interface and database support for maintenance and logistics databases.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma

  • 5+ years of Ship’s 3M coordinator experience

  • 10+ years in tandem with Naval ships experience

  • Experience monitoring ship assessments and documenting findings

  • Experience with the SKED program

  • Experience with screening, reviewing and processing Bulk upload files

  • Experience with Completing up lines of JTDI/MBPS or the old RADWEB

  • Experience with Screening and processing PMS feedback reports, Creating ACNs, and Feedback Reports

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in each of the specified areas pertaining to SURFOR's Material, Maintenance and Management (3M) Program

  • Ability to resolve problems associated with incomplete loads prior to uploading to a ship's CSMP.

  • Experience monitoring ship PMS assessments, documenting all findings about the unit and assessment team performance.

  • Experience providing inputs to CNSP Staff in the development of policy papers, Type Commander 3M inspection Team experience, and interfacing with Littoral Combat Ship Squadrons and ZUMWALT class destroyers.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must be a US Citizen and possess a current or active Secret Security clearance

Physical Requirements:

  • This position requires sedentary work, with the ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

  • The individual must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.

  • The person in this position must be capable to go onboard a ship in an operational and industrial environment, climb ladders, and go through scuttles onboard vessels.

  • The individual must occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, or to communicate with co-workers, management, and customers via email, phone, and virtual methods.

title: SAP EWM Consultant
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SAP EWM Consultant to support the implementation, configuration, integration, and optimization of SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with SAP EWM, warehouse management processes, SAP S/4HANA, and integration with other SAP modules.

Automotive industry experience is preferred, particularly candidates who have worked with automotive OEMs, distributors, dealerships, spare-parts operations, or automotive supply-chain environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and configure SAP EWM solutions.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP EWM solutions.
  • Conduct requirements gathering and fit-gap analysis.
  • Configure and support warehouse management processes, including:
    • Inbound Processing
    • Outbound Processing
    • Warehouse Internal Processes
    • Putaway and Stock Removal
    • Picking and Packing
    • Physical Inventory
    • Warehouse Replenishment
    • Goods Receipt and Goods Issue
    • Handling Units
    • Warehouse Orders and Tasks
    • Cross-Docking
    • Slotting and Rearrangement
  • Configure and support RF Framework and warehouse RF processes.
  • Support integration between SAP EWM and other SAP modules such as MM, SD, PP, and QM.
  • Work on SAP EWM integration with SAP S/4HANA.
  • Support warehouse automation and third-party system integrations where required.
  • Prepare functional specifications for technical developments.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, and UAT.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve functional issues.
  • Support data migration and master-data activities.
  • Prepare user documentation and conduct end-user training.
  • Provide post-go-live support and continuous process improvements.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, warehouse teams, developers, and other SAP consultants.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as an SAP EWM Consultant.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP EWM configuration and implementation.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse management processes.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA EWM is highly preferred.
  • Experience with inbound, outbound, internal warehouse, picking, packing, and inventory processes.
  • Experience with Warehouse Management, Handling Units, Warehouse Tasks, Warehouse Orders, and RF.
  • Experience integrating EWM with SAP modules such as MM, SD, PP, and QM.
  • Experience in requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and support.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders and warehouse operations teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent English communication skills.

Automotive Experience – Preferred

  • Automotive industry experience is preferred.
  • Experience working with automotive OEMs, distributors, dealerships, spare-parts operations, or automotive supply-chain organizations is an advantage.
  • Experience supporting SAP EWM in an automotive warehouse or spare-parts environment is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of automotive logistics, warehouse, and supply-chain processes is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP EWM certification is an advantage.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA EWM.
  • Experience with SAP EWM implementation or transformation projects.
  • Experience with warehouse automation and third-party logistics integrations.
  • Experience with SAP Activate methodology.
  • Experience in the GCC/Saudi market is a plus.
  • Automotive industry experience is preferred.

title: Market Specialist
description:
Ready to help shape the future of energy flexibility in one of the UK's most exciting and fast-moving markets? Do you enjoy turning complex market developments into commercial opportunities that create real value for customers? At EDF, Success is Personal. As a Market Specialist - Flexibility, you'll help identify, develop and deliver the next generation of flexibility services while building your expertise in a business helping drive Britain's net zero future.

The Opportunity

As a Market Specialist - Flexibility, you'll play a key role in identifying and developing new flexibility services across Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), peakers and behind-the-meter technologies. Working within our Flex Delivery team, you'll assess emerging market opportunities, build expertise in evolving flexibility markets and help shape the services that support our customers and EDF's journey towards An Electric Britain. You'll work at the heart of commercial decision-making, translating market developments into practical solutions that create value and support business growth.

Alongside a salary range of between £55,000 to £80,000 per annum, with the potential for an annual bonus, this role offers flexibility to work remotely or in a hybrid arrangement. You'll primarily work from home, with attendance required at our #London office for quarterly meetings and other business activities when needed.

This is an opportunity to become a recognised subject matter expert in a rapidly evolving area of the energy industry. You'll work across Trading & Optimisation, Technology, Product, Commercial and operational teams, influencing how EDF responds to changing market conditions and emerging opportunities. From representing the business in industry forums to helping develop new services from concept through to operational readiness, you'll play a visible role in shaping the future of flexibility markets.

Who You Are

We're looking for a Market Specialist - Flexibility who combines commercial awareness with strong analytical thinking and a curiosity about how energy markets evolve. You'll be comfortable working across teams, challenging constructively, and turning complex information into practical business recommendations. Are you experienced in...

  • Strong knowledge of UK energy markets, including flexibility, trading, optimisation or related market services
  • Assessing the commercial value and viability of emerging market opportunities
  • Experience analysing large and complex datasets using tools such as Python, SQL and VBA (Visual Basic for Applications)
  • Interpreting complex market rules, consultations and technical requirements and translating them into practical business actions
  • Supporting the development or implementation of new market services, products or trading capabilities
  • Working effectively across commercial, trading, technology and operational teams to deliver business outcomes
  • Managing multiple priorities, dependencies and stakeholders within a changing market environment
  • Producing clear recommendations and insights from complex market information

Don't meet every requirement? We know that potential comes in many forms. If you're excited about the role and believe you have the skills and aptitude to grow into it, we encourage you to apply. We're open to considering candidates who can develop into the role with the right support.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building expertise in new and emerging flexibility markets, services and industry developments
  • Assessing commercial opportunities and operational impacts across flexible energy assets
  • Translating complex market rules and requirements into clear commercial, technical and operational requirements
  • Supporting new flexibility services from initial assessment through to operational readiness and handover into delivery
  • Sharing market insight and recommendations that help shape business decisions and future services

Pay, Benefits and Culture

Alongside a salary range of between £55,000 to £80,000 per annum, potential for an annual bonus, and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.

At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That's why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that's unique to you. Here, Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us.

Everyone is welcome at EDF; we're committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities. As a Disability Confident employer, we will support applicants requiring adjustments.

Join us and find your success at EDF!

Closing Date: Sunday 20th September - however we will be reviewing applications as they come in, so the role may close earlier than stated.

#SuccessIsPersonal #EDFcareers #LI-Hybrid #LondonCareers #FlexibilityMarkets

Success is Personal. It's your journey, powered by us. Join us and drive the transition towards An Electric Britain.
